**Create `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_org_resolve_test.rs`:**

```rust
//! Resolving a dot's variables in its org (env vault spec §8): the grant first, then the org's
//! state and its `use` rules, then its `personal` mode, then the shell's secrets rule. A
//! Personal dot reads Personal only, as before.

mod common;

use chrono::Duration;
use common::fake_openbao::Failure;
use common::orgs::{keys, policy, sign, OrgsHarness, ACME, ACME_NAME, TOKEN};
use common::{spec, temp_store};
use dots_core::vault::org::OrgStatus;
use dots_core::vault::{Consumer, DotScope, EntryKind, Grants, Missing, Unresolved, Vault};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

const DOT: &str = "triage";

const ORG_BOTH: &str = "org-secret-both-3f9a1c";
const ORG_ONLY: &str = "org-secret-only-b27e44";
const ORG_PLAIN: &str = "org-plain-level-5d71e0";
const ORG_ROTATED: &str = "org-secret-rotated-0e8b37";
const PERSONAL_BOTH: &str = "personal-secret-both-91d0aa";
const PERSONAL_ONLY: &str = "personal-secret-only-6c5e12";
const PERSONAL_PLAIN: &str = "personal-plain-region-2a4f";

/// Every value a test serves or stores, which no error or `Debug` may hold.
const VALUES: &[&str] = &[
    ORG_BOTH,
    ORG_ONLY,
    ORG_PLAIN,
    ORG_ROTATED,
    PERSONAL_BOTH,
    PERSONAL_ONLY,
    PERSONAL_PLAIN,
    TOKEN,
];

fn assert_clean(text: &str) {
    for value in VALUES {
        assert!(!text.contains(value), "{text:?} holds {value:?}");
    }
}

fn github() -> Consumer {
    Consumer::Mcp("github".into())
}

fn acme() -> DotScope {
    DotScope::Org(ACME.into())
}

/// The org's entries: `BOTH` (Personal has it too), `IN_ORG`, and the plain `LOG_LEVEL`.
fn org_entries() -> Value {
    json!({"BOTH": ORG_BOTH, "IN_ORG": ORG_ONLY, "LOG_LEVEL": ORG_PLAIN})
}

/// Acme joined with `org_entries` and a policy of `extra` (with `LOG_LEVEL` plain), and
/// Personal holding `BOTH`, `IN_PERSONAL` (secrets) and the plain `REGION`.
async fn setup(extra: Value) -> (OrgsHarness, Vault) {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let mut extra = extra;
    extra["plain"] = json!(["LOG_LEVEL"]);
    h.join_acme(org_entries(), extra).await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    vault
        .add("BOTH", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_BOTH)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("IN_PERSONAL", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_ONLY)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("REGION", EntryKind::Plain, PERSONAL_PLAIN)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    (h, vault)
}

/// Resolves `name`, granted to `consumer`, in `scope`: its value, or what is missing. Neither
/// side's `Debug`, nor the missing text, holds a value.
async fn resolve(
    vault: &Vault,
    scope: &DotScope,
    consumer: &Consumer,
    name: &str,
) -> Result<String, Missing> {
    let grants = Grants([(consumer.key(), vec![name.to_string()])].into());
    let names = vec![name.to_string()];
    let resolved = vault
        .resolve(scope, &grants, consumer, &names)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    match resolved {
        Ok(resolved) => {
            assert_clean(&format!("{resolved:?}"));
            Ok(resolved.get(name).expect("the asked name"))
        }
        Err(missing) => {
            assert_clean(&format!("{missing:?}"));
            assert_clean(&missing.text(DOT));
            Err(missing)
        }
    }
}

/// What is missing for `name`, as its reason and its text.
async fn missing(
    vault: &Vault,
    scope: &DotScope,
    consumer: &Consumer,
    name: &str,
) -> (Unresolved, String) {
    let missing = resolve(vault, scope, consumer, name)
        .await
        .expect_err("a missing variable");
    assert_eq!(missing.name, name);
    assert_eq!(&missing.consumer, consumer);
    (missing.why.clone(), missing.text(DOT))
}

// The `personal` modes

#[tokio::test]
async fn under_deny_only_the_orgs_entries_resolve() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "BOTH").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_BOTH
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_PERSONAL").await,
        (
            Unresolved::NotDefined,
            "IN_PERSONAL: not in Acme Engineering (dot 'triage', mcp:github)".into()
        )
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn under_fallback_the_orgs_entry_wins_else_personal() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback"})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "BOTH").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_BOTH
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_PERSONAL")
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "NOWHERE").await,
        (
            Unresolved::NotDefined,
            "NOWHERE: not in Acme Engineering (dot 'triage', mcp:github)".into()
        )
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn under_override_personal_wins_else_the_orgs_entry() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "override"})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "BOTH").await.unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_BOTH
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_PERSONAL")
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "NOWHERE").await.0,
        Unresolved::NotDefined
    );
}

// The grant and `use`

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_name_not_granted_is_refused_before_anything_else() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "override"})).await;
    let grants = Grants([("mcp:github".to_string(), vec!["BOTH".to_string()])].into());
    let names = vec!["IN_ORG".to_string()];
    let refused = vault
        .resolve(&acme(), &grants, &github(), &names)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(refused.why, Unresolved::NotGranted);
    assert_eq!(
        refused.text(DOT),
        "IN_ORG: not granted to mcp:github in dot 'triage'"
    );

    // Even an org that is gone: the grant comes first.
    h.orgs.remove(ACME).await.unwrap();
    let refused = vault
        .resolve(&acme(), &grants, &github(), &names)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(refused.why, Unresolved::NotGranted);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn use_deny_wins_over_allow_wherever_the_value_would_come_from() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let extra = json!({
        "personal": "override",
        "use": {"allow": ["PROD_*", "*"], "deny": ["PROD_*"]},
    });
    h.join_acme(json!({"PROD_DB": ORG_BOTH, "DEV_DB": ORG_ONLY}), extra)
        .await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    vault
        .add("PROD_TOKEN", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_ONLY)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let scope = acme();
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "PROD_DB").await,
        (
            Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy,
            "PROD_DB: Acme Engineering's policy does not allow it (dot 'triage')".into()
        )
    );
    // In another case, and for a name only Personal has, which `override` would let win.
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "prod_db").await.0,
        Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &github(), "PROD_TOKEN").await.0,
        Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "DEV_DB").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
}

// The shell's secrets

#[tokio::test]
async fn the_shell_gets_no_secret_while_shell_secrets_is_false() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback", "shell_secrets": false})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    let shell = Consumer::Shell;
    // An org secret, and a Personal secret that `fallback` reaches.
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &shell, "IN_ORG").await,
        (
            Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden,
            "IN_ORG: Acme Engineering does not allow secrets in the shell (dot 'triage')".into()
        )
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &shell, "IN_PERSONAL").await.0,
        Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden
    );
    // A plain org entry and a plain Personal one are not secrets.
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &shell, "LOG_LEVEL").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_PLAIN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &shell, "REGION").await.unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_PLAIN
    );
    // The rule is the shell's: a server still gets the secret.
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn the_shell_gets_secrets_when_shell_secrets_is_true() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback", "shell_secrets": true})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    let shell = Consumer::Shell;
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &shell, "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &shell, "IN_PERSONAL")
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_ONLY
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn names_compare_without_regard_to_case() {
    let (_h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback"})).await;
    let scope = acme();
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "in_org").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &github(), "In_Personal")
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        PERSONAL_ONLY
    );
    // `plain` matches in any case too, so the shell gets it.
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &scope, &Consumer::Shell, "log_level")
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        ORG_PLAIN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &scope, &Consumer::Shell, "both").await.0,
        Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden
    );
}

// The org's state

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_offline_org_resolves_from_its_copy() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    h.bao.fail_next(Failure::Status(503), 1);
    let summary = h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        summary.status,
        OrgStatus::Offline { until: Some(_) }
    ));
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_offline_org_with_no_copy_gives_nothing() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "override", "offline_hours": 0})).await;
    h.bao.fail_next(Failure::Status(503), 1);
    let summary = h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(summary.status, OrgStatus::Offline { until: None });
    let offline = (
        Unresolved::OrgOffline,
        "Acme Engineering: offline, with no saved copy".to_string(),
    );
    assert_eq!(missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await, offline);
    // The org's state blocks every name, even one `override` would take from Personal.
    assert_eq!(missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "BOTH").await, offline);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_expired_copy_gives_nothing() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback", "offline_hours": 2})).await;
    h.bao.fail_next(Failure::Status(503), 1);
    h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    h.advance(Duration::hours(2));
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await,
        (
            Unresolved::OrgExpired,
            "Acme Engineering: secrets expired offline; reconnect to refresh".into()
        )
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_PERSONAL").await.0,
        Unresolved::OrgExpired
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_revoked_org_gives_nothing() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "override"})).await;
    h.bao.revoke_token(TOKEN);
    let summary = h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(summary.status, OrgStatus::Revoked);
    let revoked = (
        Unresolved::OrgRevoked,
        "Acme Engineering: access revoked".to_string(),
    );
    assert_eq!(missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await, revoked);
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_PERSONAL").await,
        revoked
    );
}

/// Serves Acme's entries, rotated, under a policy signed with a key that is not the org's.
fn serve_badly_signed(h: &OrgsHarness, extra: Value) {
    let signed = sign(&keys(), &policy(ACME, "2026-10-22T10:00:00Z", extra));
    h.serve("dots", json!({"IN_ORG": ORG_ROTATED}), &signed);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_invalid_policy_keeps_the_last_good_copy() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    serve_badly_signed(&h, json!({}));
    let summary = h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(summary.status, OrgStatus::PolicyInvalid { .. }));
    assert_eq!(
        resolve(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await.unwrap(),
        ORG_ONLY
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_invalid_policy_with_no_copy_gives_nothing() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback", "offline_hours": 0})).await;
    serve_badly_signed(&h, json!({"offline_hours": 0}));
    let summary = h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    let OrgStatus::PolicyInvalid { error } = summary.status else {
        panic!("{summary:?}");
    };
    assert!(!error.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await,
        (
            Unresolved::PolicyInvalid(error.clone()),
            format!("Acme Engineering: policy invalid: {error}")
        )
    );
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_PERSONAL").await.0,
        Unresolved::PolicyInvalid(error)
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_removed_org_gives_nothing() {
    let (h, vault) = setup(json!({"personal": "override"})).await;
    h.orgs.remove(ACME).await.unwrap();
    let removed = (
        Unresolved::OrgRemoved,
        "dot 'triage': its org 'acme-eng' was removed".to_string(),
    );
    assert_eq!(missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG").await, removed);
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_PERSONAL").await,
        removed
    );
    let gone = resolve(&vault, &acme(), &github(), "IN_ORG")
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(gone.org.as_deref(), Some(ACME));
}

#[test]
fn every_missing_text_is_exact() {
    let text = |name: &str, consumer: Consumer, why: Unresolved, org: Option<&str>| {
        Missing {
            name: name.into(),
            consumer,
            why,
            org: org.map(str::to_string),
        }
        .text("D")
    };
    let acme = Some(ACME_NAME);
    let x = || Consumer::Mcp("x".into());
    let cases = [
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::NotGranted, acme),
            "NAME: not granted to mcp:x in dot 'D'",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::NotDefined, acme),
            "NAME: not in Acme Engineering (dot 'D', mcp:x)",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::NotDefined, None),
            "NAME: not in Personal (dot 'D', mcp:x)",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy, acme),
            "NAME: Acme Engineering's policy does not allow it (dot 'D')",
        ),
        (
            text(
                "NAME",
                Consumer::Shell,
                Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden,
                acme,
            ),
            "NAME: Acme Engineering does not allow secrets in the shell (dot 'D')",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::OrgExpired, acme),
            "Acme Engineering: secrets expired offline; reconnect to refresh",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::OrgRevoked, acme),
            "Acme Engineering: access revoked",
        ),
        (
            text(
                "NAME",
                x(),
                Unresolved::PolicyInvalid("signature does not match".into()),
                acme,
            ),
            "Acme Engineering: policy invalid: signature does not match",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::OrgOffline, acme),
            "Acme Engineering: offline, with no saved copy",
        ),
        (
            text("NAME", x(), Unresolved::OrgRemoved, Some(ACME)),
            "dot 'D': its org 'acme-eng' was removed",
        ),
    ];
    for (got, want) in cases {
        assert_eq!(got, want);
    }
}
```

```rust
// One view: the policy and the values of the same fetch

fn asked(list: &[&str]) -> Vec<String> {
    list.iter().map(|n| n.to_string()).collect()
}

/// `view` answers from one read of the org: while a refresh that brings a new policy and new
/// values waits on the network, the view is the old fetch's policy with the old values; once it
/// lands, the new policy with the new values. Never one fetch's values with another's policy.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_view_gives_the_policy_and_the_values_of_one_fetch() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let scripted = Scripted::new();
    let orgs = h.service().with_sources(scripted.factory());
    let first = sign(&h.keys, &policy(ACME, ISSUED, acme_policy()));
    scripted.serve(&[("API_KEY", API_KEY), ("LOG_LEVEL", LOG_LEVEL)], &first);
    orgs.join(&h.acme_code(), Some(token())).await.unwrap();
    scripted.entered().await;
    let asked = asked(&["api_key", "LOG_LEVEL", "NOT_THERE"]);

    let view = orgs.view(ACME, &asked).await;
    let policy_of = |view: &OrgView| view.policy.clone().expect("a policy");
    assert_eq!(policy_of(&view).issued_at, ISSUED);
    assert_eq!(policy_of(&view).personal, PersonalMode::Fallback);
    assert_eq!(
        view.lookups,
        [
            value(API_KEY, false),
            value(LOG_LEVEL, true),
            OrgLookup::NotDefined
        ]
    );

    // The next fetch makes API_KEY plain, LOG_LEVEL gone, and Personal denied.
    const LATER: &str = "2026-10-22T08:30:00Z";
    let gate = scripted.hold();
    let second = json!({"plain": ["API_KEY"], "personal": "deny"});
    scripted.serve(
        &[("API_KEY", ROTATED)],
        &sign(&h.keys, &policy(ACME, LATER, second)),
    );
    let refreshing = tokio::spawn({
        let orgs = orgs.clone();
        async move { orgs.refresh(ACME).await }
    });
    scripted.entered().await;
    assert_eq!(
        orgs.view(ACME, &asked).await,
        view,
        "the fetch has not landed"
    );

    gate.add_permits(1);
    refreshing.await.unwrap().unwrap();
    let view = orgs.view(ACME, &asked).await;
    assert_eq!(policy_of(&view).issued_at, LATER);
    assert_eq!(policy_of(&view).personal, PersonalMode::Deny);
    assert_eq!(
        view.lookups,
        [
            value(ROTATED, true),
            OrgLookup::NotDefined,
            OrgLookup::NotDefined
        ]
    );
    assert!(!format!("{view:?}").contains(ROTATED));
}

/// `view` expires a copy that ran out, as `lookup` does, and answers `Removed` for an org that
/// is not joined.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_view_expires_as_lookup_does_and_names_why_there_are_no_values() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let extra = json!({"plain": ["LOG_LEVEL"], "offline_hours": 2});
    h.join_acme(entries(), extra).await;
    let asked = asked(&["API_KEY", "LOG_LEVEL"]);
    h.advance(Duration::hours(1));
    h.bao.fail_next(Failure::Status(503), 1);
    h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();

    h.advance(Duration::minutes(59));
    let view = h.orgs.view(ACME, &asked).await;
    assert_eq!(
        view.lookups,
        [value(API_KEY, false), value(LOG_LEVEL, true)]
    );
    h.advance(Duration::minutes(1));
    let view = h.orgs.view(ACME, &asked).await;
    assert_eq!(view.lookups, [OrgLookup::Expired, OrgLookup::Expired]);
    assert!(!h.copy_path(ACME).exists(), "the view deleted the copy");
    assert_eq!(
        status_of(&h.orgs, ACME).await,
        OrgStatus::Expired,
        "as lookup would have left it"
    );

    let view = h.orgs.view("beta", &asked).await;
    assert_eq!(
        view,
        OrgView {
            policy: None,
            lookups: vec![OrgLookup::Removed, OrgLookup::Removed],
        }
    );
    assert!(h.orgs.view(ACME, &[]).await.lookups.is_empty());
}
```

```rust
    /// The org's accepted policy and its answer for each of `names`, from one read of the org:
    /// for the resolver, which applies the policy to the values it was accepted with. The
    /// expiry is that of `lookup`.
    pub async fn view(&self, org_id: &str, names: &[String]) -> OrgView {
        self.expire_if_due(org_id).await;
        let orgs = self.read();
        let each = |answer: &dyn Fn(&str) -> OrgLookup| names.iter().map(|n| answer(n)).collect();
        match orgs.get(org_id) {
            Some(Slot::Joined(joined)) => OrgView {
                policy: joined.policy.clone(),
                lookups: each(&|name| joined.lookup(name)),
            },
            Some(Slot::Damaged { error, .. }) => OrgView {
                policy: None,
                lookups: each(&|_| OrgLookup::PolicyInvalid(error.clone())),
            },
            Some(Slot::Pending(_)) | None => OrgView {
                policy: None,
                lookups: each(&|_| OrgLookup::Removed),
            },
        }
```

```rust
    /// What a run of `dot`, or a save of it, is refused with when its org is not joined on
    /// this PC; `None` for a Personal dot or a joined org.
    pub fn org_removed(&self, dot: &Dot) -> Option<String> {
        let DotScope::Org(org_id) = DotScope::of(dot) else {
            return None;
        };
        let joined = self.orgs().is_some_and(|orgs| orgs.is_joined(&org_id));
        (!joined).then(|| org_removed_text(&dot.spec.name, &org_id))
    }

    /// Before a run of `dot` starts (§6.4): a dot whose org is not joined does not start, and
    /// an org whose last good fetch is older than its `refresh_minutes` is fetched first. A
    /// fetch that fails leaves the org as the fetch left it: its saved copy, while that holds,
    /// or the reason it gives nothing, which resolving then names.
    pub async fn before_run(&self, dot: &Dot) -> Result<()> {
        if let Some(text) = self.org_removed(dot) {
            return Err(Error::Other(text));
        }
        if let (DotScope::Org(org_id), Some(orgs)) = (DotScope::of(dot), self.orgs()) {
            if let Err(e) = orgs.refresh_if_stale(&org_id).await {
                tracing::warn!("org {org_id:?} was not refreshed before a run: {e}");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The org's name for the texts, or its id when it is not joined.
    async fn org_name(&self, org_id: &str) -> String {
        match self.orgs() {
            Some(orgs) => orgs.summary(org_id).await.map(|s| s.name),
            None => None,
        }
        .unwrap_or_else(|| org_id.to_string())
    }

    /// The value of `name` for `consumer`, from the org's `lookup` of it and the `policy`
    /// accepted with it (one `Orgs::view`), or why there is none. The org's state comes first:
    /// an org that gives no values blocks every name, even one Personal has.
    async fn org_value(
        &self,
        lookup: &OrgLookup,
        policy: Option<&OrgPolicy>,
        consumer: &Consumer,
        name: &str,
    ) -> Result<std::result::Result<Zeroizing<String>, Unresolved>> {
        // The org's value and whether it is a secret, if it has one.
        let in_org = match lookup {
            OrgLookup::Value { value, is_plain } => Some((value.clone(), !is_plain)),
            OrgLookup::NotDefined => None,
            OrgLookup::Expired => return Ok(Err(Unresolved::OrgExpired)),
            OrgLookup::Revoked => return Ok(Err(Unresolved::OrgRevoked)),
            OrgLookup::PolicyInvalid(error) => {
                return Ok(Err(Unresolved::PolicyInvalid(error.clone())))
            }
            OrgLookup::Offline => return Ok(Err(Unresolved::OrgOffline)),
            OrgLookup::Removed => return Ok(Err(Unresolved::OrgRemoved)),
        };
        // An org that gives values has an accepted policy. Without one, nothing is guessed.
        let Some(policy) = policy else {
            let error = "no policy has been accepted".to_string();
            return Ok(Err(Unresolved::PolicyInvalid(error)));
        };
        if !policy.may_use(name) {
            return Ok(Err(Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy));
        }
        let chosen = match policy.personal {
            PersonalMode::Deny => in_org,
            PersonalMode::Fallback => match in_org {
                Some(found) => Some(found),
                None => self.personal_entry(name).await?,
            },
            PersonalMode::Override => match self.personal_entry(name).await? {
                Some(found) => Some(found),
                None => in_org,
            },
        };
        let Some((value, secret)) = chosen else {
            return Ok(Err(Unresolved::NotDefined));
        };
        if *consumer == Consumer::Shell && secret && !policy.shell_secrets {
            return Ok(Err(Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden));
        }
        Ok(Ok(value))
    }
}
```

### Task 10: MCP catalogs kept per scope

Spec §8: a server's tool list can differ by credential. So the accepted list and the held status are kept per (server, scope), a run uses its dot's scope, and the Library's Check resolves in a scope.

**Files:**

- Modify: `crates/dots-core/migrations/0013_orgs.sql` (the `mcp_catalogs` rebuild, appended), `crates/dots-core/src/library.rs` (`PERSONAL_SCOPE`), `crates/dots-core/src/store/library.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/vault/resolve.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/vault/org/join.rs` (`personal` refused), `crates/dots-core/src/library_service.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/run_tools.rs`, `apps/dots-app/src/commands.rs`
- Tests: `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_org_catalog_test.rs` (new); `vault_org_policy_test.rs` (+1); a scope at the existing catalog calls of `store_library_test.rs`, `library_service_test.rs`, `run_tools_test.rs`, `vault_grants_test.rs` and `claude_gateway_test.rs`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 9's `DotScope`, `Vault::resolve`, `Orgs::view`.
- Produces:
  - `library::PERSONAL_SCOPE = "personal"`; `DotScope::key() -> &str`.
  - `Store::{get_catalog(server_id, scope), list_catalogs() -> Vec<(String, McpCatalog)>, put_catalog(scope, &catalog), record_catalog_seen(server_id, scope, fingerprint, tools), record_catalog_failure(server_id, scope, error), accept_catalog(server_id, scope, fingerprint), changed_mcp_servers(scope)}`.
    - A scope is `personal` or an org id, else `Invalid("\"x\" is not a scope: it is \"personal\" or an org id")`.
    - An org's row is made by its first record; a missing one reads `unchecked` and writes nothing.
    - A config change resets every scope, and a delete removes every scope.
  - `Vault::check_values(scope, consumer, names)`: an org not joined is `NotFound("no org 'x' is joined on this PC")`. `Missing::check_text()` names the variable and the scope, never a dot: "`NAME`: not in Acme Engineering".
  - `LibraryService::{check(id, &DotScope), accept(id, &DotScope, fingerprint)}`. The app's `library_check` and `library_accept` pass Personal; their `scope` argument comes in Task 12.
  - `check_org_id("personal")` is `Invalid("'personal' is reserved for your own keys; choose another org id")`.

**Create `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_org_catalog_test.rs`:**

```rust
//! MCP catalogs kept per scope (env vault spec §8): a server's tool list accepted with
//! Personal's values and one accepted with an org's are kept apart, a change to the server
//! resets both and a delete removes both. The Library's Check runs in a chosen scope and, for an
//! org, resolves the server's variables as a run in that org would. A run reads the catalog of
//! its dot's scope. Migration 0013 keeps every catalog made before it as Personal's.

mod common;

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::time::Duration as StdDuration;

use chrono::Duration;
use common::fake_mcp::{tool, FakeMcp};
use common::fake_openbao::Failure;
use common::orgs::{OrgsHarness, ACME, TOKEN};
use dots_core::events::new_bus;
use dots_core::library::{
    CatalogStatus, LibraryConfig, LibraryItem, McpCatalog, Uses, PERSONAL_SCOPE,
};
use dots_core::library_service::LibraryService;
use dots_core::mcp::fingerprint;
use dots_core::run_tools::{OpenRequest, RunTools};
use dots_core::store::Store;
use dots_core::vault::{DotScope, EntryKind, Grants, Vault};
use dots_core::Error;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use sqlx::sqlite::{SqliteConnectOptions, SqlitePool};
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

const ORG_KEY: &str = "org-secret-api-key-71c0d2";
const ORG_PROD: &str = "org-secret-prod-db-4e9a17";
const PERSONAL_KEY: &str = "personal-secret-api-key-0b6f3e";
const PERSONAL_ONLY: &str = "personal-secret-only-c8d215";

/// Every value a test serves or stores, which no stored error may hold.
const VALUES: &[&str] = &[ORG_KEY, ORG_PROD, PERSONAL_KEY, PERSONAL_ONLY, TOKEN];

fn assert_clean(text: &str) {
    for value in VALUES {
        assert!(!text.contains(value), "{text:?} holds {value:?}");
    }
}

fn acme() -> DotScope {
    DotScope::Org(ACME.into())
}

/// A catalog in which `fp` was seen and is waiting for review.
fn seen(server_id: &str, fp: &str) -> McpCatalog {
    McpCatalog {
        seen_fingerprint: Some(fp.into()),
        seen_tools: Some(json!([{"name": fp}])),
        status: CatalogStatus::Changed,
        checked_at: Some("2026-10-22T09:00:00.000Z".into()),
        ..McpCatalog::unchecked(server_id)
    }
}

fn stdio(command: &str) -> LibraryConfig {
    LibraryConfig::McpServer(
        serde_json::from_value(json!({"transport": "stdio", "command": command})).unwrap(),
    )
}

async fn add_server(store: &Store, name: &str) -> LibraryItem {
    store
        .add_library_item(name, &stdio("sf-mcp"), None)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}

/// The catalogs stored for `server_id`, by scope.
async fn scopes_of(store: &Store, server_id: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    store
        .list_catalogs()
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|(_, c)| c.server_id == server_id)
        .map(|(scope, _)| scope)
        .collect()
}

// Migration 0013

/// A database Dots left at 0012, with a server whose list was accepted and one never checked:
/// both catalogs come out as Personal's with every field, and a second scope can be added.
#[tokio::test]
async fn migration_0013_keeps_every_catalog_as_personal() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = dir.path().join("dots.db");
    let opts = SqliteConnectOptions::new()
        .filename(&path)
        .create_if_missing(true)
        .foreign_keys(true);
    let pool = SqlitePool::connect_with(opts).await.unwrap();
    let mut before = sqlx::migrate!("./migrations");
    before.migrations = before
        .migrations
        .iter()
        .filter(|m| m.version < 13)
        .cloned()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .into();
    before.run(&pool).await.unwrap();
    for (id, name) in [("S1", "sf"), ("S2", "gh")] {
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO library_items (id, kind, name, config, owner_id, created_at, \
             updated_at) VALUES (?, 'mcp_server', ?, ?, NULL, '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', \
             '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z')",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .bind(name)
        .bind(json!({"transport": "stdio", "command": "sf-mcp"}).to_string())
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    }
    let tools = json!([{"name": "query", "annotations": {"readOnlyHint": true}}]);
    sqlx::query(
        "INSERT INTO mcp_catalogs (server_id, accepted_fingerprint, accepted_tools, \
         seen_fingerprint, seen_tools, status, checked_at, error) \
         VALUES ('S1', 'f1', ?, 'f2', '[]', 'unreachable', '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z', \
         'could not start: timed out')",
    )
    .bind(tools.to_string())
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    sqlx::query("INSERT INTO mcp_catalogs (server_id, status) VALUES ('S2', 'unchecked')")
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    pool.close().await;

    let store = Store::open(&path).await.unwrap();
    let s1 = McpCatalog {
        server_id: "S1".into(),
        status: CatalogStatus::Unreachable,
        accepted_fingerprint: Some("f1".into()),
        accepted_tools: Some(tools),
        seen_fingerprint: Some("f2".into()),
        seen_tools: Some(json!([])),
        checked_at: Some("2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z".into()),
        error: Some("could not start: timed out".into()),
    };
    assert_eq!(
        store.list_catalogs().await.unwrap(),
        [
            (PERSONAL_SCOPE.to_string(), s1.clone()),
            (PERSONAL_SCOPE.to_string(), McpCatalog::unchecked("S2")),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(store.get_catalog("S1", PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(), s1);

    // The key is the server and the scope; the server's delete still takes every scope's.
    store.put_catalog(ACME, &seen("S1", "f9")).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&store, "S1").await, [ACME, PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
    assert_eq!(store.get_catalog("S1", PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(), s1);
    store.remove_library_item("S1").await.unwrap();
    assert!(scopes_of(&store, "S1").await.is_empty());

    let pool = SqlitePool::connect(&format!("sqlite://{}", path.display()))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let key: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('mcp_catalogs') WHERE pk > 0 ORDER BY pk",
    )
    .fetch_all(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(key, ["server_id", "scope"]);
    let tables: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name LIKE 'mcp_catalogs%'",
    )
    .fetch_all(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tables, ["mcp_catalogs"]);
    pool.close().await;
}

// The store

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_new_server_has_an_unchecked_personal_catalog_and_none_stored_in_an_org() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let sf = add_server(&h.store, "sf").await;
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &sf.id).await, [PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
    let unchecked = McpCatalog::unchecked(&sf.id);
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(),
        unchecked
    );
    // Never checked in the org: it reads as unchecked, and nothing is stored for it.
    assert_eq!(h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, ACME).await.unwrap(), unchecked);
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &sf.id).await, [PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
    // Nothing seen in the org: nothing to accept there.
    let err = h
        .store
        .accept_catalog(&sf.id, ACME, "f1")
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Conflict(_)), "{err:?}");

    let err = h.store.get_catalog("nope", ACME).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(err, Error::NotFound(_)), "{err:?}");
    let err = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_seen("nope", ACME, "f1", &json!([]))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(err, Error::NotFound(_)), "{err:?}");
    for bad in ["", "Personal", "../x", "acme eng"] {
        let err = h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, bad).await.unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Invalid(_)), "{bad:?}: {err:?}");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn the_first_record_in_an_org_makes_its_catalog() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let sf = add_server(&h.store, "sf").await;
    let tools = json!([{"name": "query"}]);
    let c = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_seen(&sf.id, ACME, "f1", &tools)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(c.seen_tools, Some(tools));
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &sf.id).await, [ACME, PERSONAL_SCOPE]);

    let gh = add_server(&h.store, "gh").await;
    let c = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_failure(&gh.id, ACME, "API_KEY: not in Acme Engineering")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Unreachable);
    assert_eq!(c.error.as_deref(), Some("API_KEY: not in Acme Engineering"));
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &gh.id).await, [ACME, PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.get_catalog(&gh.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(),
        McpCatalog::unchecked(&gh.id)
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn two_scopes_of_one_server_are_kept_apart() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let sf = add_server(&h.store, "sf").await;

    // Accepted in Personal; the org has not seen it.
    h.store
        .record_catalog_seen(&sf.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, "f1", &json!([]))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let accepted = h
        .store
        .accept_catalog(&sf.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, "f1")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(accepted.status, CatalogStatus::Accepted);
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, ACME).await.unwrap(),
        McpCatalog::unchecked(&sf.id)
    );
    // The same list seen in the org is not accepted there: Personal's accept is Personal's.
    let in_org = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_seen(&sf.id, ACME, "f1", &json!([]))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(in_org.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(in_org.accepted_fingerprint, None);
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.changed_mcp_servers(ACME).await.unwrap(),
        std::slice::from_ref(&sf)
    );
    assert!(h
        .store
        .changed_mcp_servers(PERSONAL_SCOPE)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_empty());

    // The other way: accepted in the org, while Personal sees another list.
    let gh = add_server(&h.store, "gh").await;
    h.store
        .put_catalog(ACME, &seen(&gh.id, "g1"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store.accept_catalog(&gh.id, ACME, "g1").await.unwrap();
    let personal = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_seen(&gh.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, "g2", &json!([]))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(personal.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(personal.accepted_fingerprint, None);
    let err = h
        .store
        .accept_catalog(&gh.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, "g1")
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Conflict(_)), "{err:?}");
    let org = h.store.get_catalog(&gh.id, ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(org.status, CatalogStatus::Accepted);
    assert_eq!(org.accepted_fingerprint.as_deref(), Some("g1"));
    // A failure in one scope leaves the other.
    h.store
        .record_catalog_failure(&gh.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, "could not start")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(h.store.get_catalog(&gh.id, ACME).await.unwrap(), org);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn changing_a_server_resets_its_catalog_in_every_scope() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let sf = add_server(&h.store, "sf").await;
    for (scope, fp) in [(PERSONAL_SCOPE, "p1"), (ACME, "o1")] {
        h.store.put_catalog(scope, &seen(&sf.id, fp)).await.unwrap();
        h.store.accept_catalog(&sf.id, scope, fp).await.unwrap();
    }
    h.store
        .update_library_item(&sf.id, &stdio("sf-mcp-2"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for (scope, fp) in [(PERSONAL_SCOPE, "p1"), (ACME, "o1")] {
        let c = h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, scope).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Unchecked, "{scope}");
        assert_eq!(c.seen_fingerprint, None, "{scope}");
        assert_eq!(c.checked_at, None, "{scope}");
        // The accepted list stays for the review, in each scope.
        assert_eq!(c.accepted_fingerprint.as_deref(), Some(fp), "{scope}");
    }

    // An http server that moves to another origin keeps nothing accepted, in any scope.
    let http = |url: &str| {
        LibraryConfig::McpServer(
            serde_json::from_value(json!({"transport": "http", "url": url})).unwrap(),
        )
    };
    let gh = h
        .store
        .add_library_item("gh", &http("https://a.example.invalid/mcp"), None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for scope in [PERSONAL_SCOPE, ACME] {
        h.store
            .put_catalog(scope, &seen(&gh.id, "h1"))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        h.store.accept_catalog(&gh.id, scope, "h1").await.unwrap();
    }
    h.store
        .update_library_item(&gh.id, &http("https://b.example.invalid/mcp"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for scope in [PERSONAL_SCOPE, ACME] {
        let c = h.store.get_catalog(&gh.id, scope).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c, McpCatalog::unchecked(&gh.id), "{scope}");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn deleting_a_server_deletes_its_catalog_in_every_scope() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let sf = add_server(&h.store, "sf").await;
    let gh = add_server(&h.store, "gh").await;
    h.store
        .put_catalog(ACME, &seen(&sf.id, "o1"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store
        .put_catalog("beta", &seen(&sf.id, "b1"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        scopes_of(&h.store, &sf.id).await,
        [ACME, "beta", PERSONAL_SCOPE]
    );

    h.store.remove_library_item(&sf.id).await.unwrap();
    assert!(scopes_of(&h.store, &sf.id).await.is_empty());
    for scope in [PERSONAL_SCOPE, ACME, "beta"] {
        let err = h.store.get_catalog(&sf.id, scope).await.unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(err, Error::NotFound(_)), "{scope}: {err:?}");
    }
    let err = h
        .store
        .record_catalog_failure(&sf.id, ACME, "gone")
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(err, Error::NotFound(_)), "{err:?}");
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &gh.id).await, [PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
}

// The Library's Check in a scope

/// Acme joined with `API_KEY` and `PROD_DB`, a policy of `extra`, and Personal holding
/// `API_KEY` and `IN_PERSONAL`; the Library on that vault.
async fn setup(extra: Value) -> (OrgsHarness, Vault, LibraryService) {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    h.join_acme(json!({"API_KEY": ORG_KEY, "PROD_DB": ORG_PROD}), extra)
        .await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    vault
        .add("API_KEY", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_KEY)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("IN_PERSONAL", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_ONLY)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let lib = LibraryService::new(h.store.clone(), new_bus()).with_vault(vault.clone());
    (h, vault, lib)
}

/// A `fake-mcp` server named `name` that reads `${var}` into its `FAKE_MCP_VALUE`.
async fn server_reading(store: &Store, name: &str, var: &str) -> (FakeMcp, LibraryItem) {
    let fake = FakeMcp::new(json!({"tools": [tool("query", true)]}));
    let env = BTreeMap::from([("FAKE_MCP_VALUE".to_string(), format!("${{{var}}}"))]);
    let config = LibraryConfig::McpServer(fake.stdio_with(Vec::new(), env));
    let item = store.add_library_item(name, &config, None).await.unwrap();
    (fake, item)
}

/// The `FAKE_MCP_VALUE` each start of the server had.
fn started_with(fake: &FakeMcp) -> Vec<String> {
    fake.log()
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|r| r.get("start").cloned())
        .map(|s| {
            s["env"]["FAKE_MCP_VALUE"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string()
        })
        .collect()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_in_an_org_reads_the_orgs_value_into_the_orgs_catalog() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "API_KEY").await;

    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Changed, "{c:?}");
    assert_eq!(started_with(&fake), [ORG_KEY]);
    let in_org = h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(in_org, c);
    let fp = in_org.seen_fingerprint.clone().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(),
        McpCatalog::unchecked(&item.id),
        "Personal's catalog is not touched"
    );

    let accepted = lib.accept(&item.id, &acme(), &fp).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(accepted.status, CatalogStatus::Accepted);
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &DotScope::Personal).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(started_with(&fake), [ORG_KEY, PERSONAL_KEY]);
    assert_eq!(h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, ACME).await.unwrap(), accepted);
    let tools = c.seen_tools.clone().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fingerprint(&serde_json::from_value::<Vec<_>>(tools).unwrap()),
        fp,
        "the same list, in both scopes"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_in_an_org_under_fallback_reads_a_personal_value_the_org_lacks() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "fallback"})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "IN_PERSONAL").await;
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Changed, "{c:?}");
    assert_eq!(started_with(&fake), [PERSONAL_ONLY]);

    // Under fallback the org's own entry still wins.
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "gh", "API_KEY").await;
    lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(started_with(&fake), [ORG_KEY]);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_in_an_org_that_lacks_a_variable_names_the_scope_and_the_variable() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "IN_PERSONAL").await;
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Unreachable);
    assert_eq!(
        c.error.as_deref(),
        Some("IN_PERSONAL: not in Acme Engineering")
    );
    assert!(fake.log().is_empty(), "the server was not started");
    assert_eq!(h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, ACME).await.unwrap(), c);
    assert_eq!(
        h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE).await.unwrap(),
        McpCatalog::unchecked(&item.id)
    );

    // In Personal the same server starts with Personal's value.
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &DotScope::Personal).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(started_with(&fake), [PERSONAL_ONLY]);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_of_a_name_the_orgs_use_rules_deny_fails_without_a_value() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) =
        setup(json!({"personal": "override", "use": {"deny": ["PROD_*"]}})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "db", "PROD_DB").await;
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Unreachable);
    let error = c.error.clone().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        error,
        "PROD_DB: Acme Engineering's policy does not allow it"
    );
    assert_clean(&error);
    assert_clean(&format!("{c:?}"));
    assert!(fake.log().is_empty(), "the server was not started");
    assert!(!error.contains("dot"), "a check names no dot: {error}");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_in_an_expired_or_revoked_org_fails_with_its_reason() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "override", "offline_hours": 2})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "API_KEY").await;
    h.bao.fail_next(Failure::Status(503), 1);
    h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    h.advance(Duration::hours(2));
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.status, CatalogStatus::Unreachable);
    assert_eq!(
        c.error.as_deref(),
        Some("API_KEY: Acme Engineering: secrets expired offline; reconnect to refresh")
    );

    // Reconnected, then revoked.
    h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    h.bao.revoke_token(TOKEN);
    h.orgs.refresh(ACME).await.unwrap();
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        c.error.as_deref(),
        Some("API_KEY: Acme Engineering: access revoked")
    );
    assert_clean(&format!("{c:?}"));
    assert!(fake.log().is_empty(), "the server was never started");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_check_in_an_org_that_is_not_joined_is_refused() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "API_KEY").await;
    let err = lib
        .check(&item.id, &DotScope::Org("beta".into()))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, Error::NotFound(m) if m == "no org 'beta' is joined on this PC"),
        "{err:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(scopes_of(&h.store, &item.id).await, [PERSONAL_SCOPE]);
    assert!(fake.log().is_empty());

    // A vault with no orgs at all refuses every org.
    let plain = LibraryService::new(h.store.clone(), new_bus())
        .with_vault(Vault::new(h.store.clone(), h.secrets.clone()));
    let err = plain.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, Error::NotFound(m) if m == "no org 'acme-eng' is joined on this PC"),
        "{err:?}"
    );
}

// A run reads its dot's scope

async fn open(h: &OrgsHarness, vault: &Vault, scope: &DotScope, name: &str) -> RunTools {
    let uses = Uses {
        mcp_servers: vec![name.to_string()],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let grants = Grants([(format!("mcp:{name}"), vec!["API_KEY".to_string()])].into());
    let (tools, notices) = RunTools::open(OpenRequest {
        store: &h.store,
        bus: &new_bus(),
        run_id: "01RUN",
        uses: &uses,
        workspace: h.data.path(),
        plugins_dir: None,
        cancel: &CancellationToken::new(),
        vault,
        scope,
        grants: &grants,
        dot_name: "triage",
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tools.servers().len(), 1, "{notices:?}");
    tools
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_run_in_an_org_dot_reads_the_orgs_catalog_not_personals() {
    let (h, vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    let (fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "API_KEY").await;

    // Accepted in Personal only: a run in the org has never seen it, so it is held, as an
    // unchecked server is, and its list is recorded in the org's catalog.
    let c = lib.check(&item.id, &DotScope::Personal).await.unwrap();
    let fp = c.seen_fingerprint.unwrap();
    lib.accept(&item.id, &DotScope::Personal, &fp)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let tools = open(&h, &vault, &acme(), "sf").await;
    assert!(tools.servers()[0].held());
    assert_eq!(tools.servers()[0].accepted_fingerprint(), None);
    tools.close().await;
    let in_org = h.store.get_catalog(&item.id, ACME).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(in_org.status, CatalogStatus::Changed);
    assert_eq!(in_org.seen_fingerprint.as_deref(), Some(fp.as_str()));
    assert_eq!(
        h.store
            .get_catalog(&item.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .status,
        CatalogStatus::Accepted
    );
    // A Personal run of the same server is not held.
    let tools = open(&h, &vault, &DotScope::Personal, "sf").await;
    assert!(!tools.servers()[0].held());
    tools.close().await;

    // Accepted in the org: an org run is not held, and reads the org's value.
    lib.accept(&item.id, &acme(), &fp).await.unwrap();
    let tools = open(&h, &vault, &acme(), "sf").await;
    assert!(!tools.servers()[0].held());
    assert_eq!(
        tools.servers()[0].accepted_fingerprint().as_deref(),
        Some(fp.as_str())
    );
    tools.close().await;
    assert_eq!(
        started_with(&fake),
        [PERSONAL_KEY, ORG_KEY, PERSONAL_KEY, ORG_KEY]
    );
    assert!(fake.gone_within(StdDuration::from_secs(10)).await);
}
```

```rust
    }
```
```rust
}
```

```rust
    )))
```
```rust
}

    /// The words stored on a server's catalog when its Check in an org's scope fails
    /// (`Vault::check_values`): the variable, the scope and why, and never a dot.
    pub fn check_text(&self) -> String {
        let name = &self.name;
        let org = self.org.as_deref().unwrap_or("Personal");
        match &self.why {
            Unresolved::NotGranted => format!("{name}: not granted"),
            Unresolved::NotDefined => format!("{name}: not in {org}"),
            Unresolved::DeniedByPolicy => format!("{name}: {org}'s policy does not allow it"),
            Unresolved::ShellSecretsForbidden => {
                format!("{name}: {org} does not allow secrets in the shell")
            }
            Unresolved::OrgExpired => {
                format!("{name}: {org}: secrets expired offline; reconnect to refresh")
            }
            Unresolved::OrgRevoked => format!("{name}: {org}: access revoked"),
            Unresolved::PolicyInvalid(error) => format!("{name}: {org}: policy invalid: {error}"),
            Unresolved::OrgOffline => format!("{name}: {org}: offline, with no saved copy"),
            Unresolved::OrgRemoved => format!("{name}: no org '{org}' is joined on this PC"),
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 11: Pinning the origin an HTTP server sends variables to

Spec §8: an http server whose URL reads `${VAR}` starts in a run only when its scope's values reach an origin confirmed in that scope. The servers of before are confirmed once, at the first start.

**Files:**

- Modify: `crates/dots-core/migrations/0013_orgs.sql` (`library_items.confirmed_origins` and the `upgrade_0013` marker, appended), `crates/dots-core/src/library.rs` (`origin_pinned`, `url_variables`), `crates/dots-core/src/store/library.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/store/upgrade.rs` (`finish_0013`), `crates/dots-core/src/store/mod.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/runtime.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/library_service.rs`, `crates/dots-core/src/run_tools.rs`, `apps/dots-app/src/confirm.rs` (with 2 tests)
- Tests: `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_org_origin_test.rs` (new); `vault_grants_test.rs` (+3, the migration)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 10's scopes and `check_values`; plan A's `http_origin`, `HttpOrigin`, `confirm_library`.
- Produces:
  - `McpServerConfig::origin_pinned()`: an `Http` config whose `url` reads a variable. A header-only variable does not pin it.
  - `Store::{confirmed_origins(server_id) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>>, add_confirmed_origin(server_id, scope, origin), finish_0013(&Vault) -> usize}`.
    - `confirmed_origins` is `{scope: [origin, …]}` on the item's row. Confirmations only grow.
    - `finish_0013` runs at `Runtime::start`, after `move_stored_literals`. It records each pinned server's current Personal origin, then drops `upgrade_0013`.
  - `LibraryService::{origin_in(id, &DotScope) -> Result<Result<HttpOrigin, String>>, add_confirmed_origin(id, &DotScope, origin)}`.
  - The notice at spawn is "github: http://127.0.0.1:61234 is not a confirmed origin; open the server in the Library to confirm it". The server is left out of the run, and the catalog is not touched.
  - App: `confirm_library` returns the origins its question named (`Allowed`), and `add_confirmed` and `update_confirmed` record them in Personal after the save.

```rust
/// A database Dots left at 0012 at `path`, holding the Library `servers` (id, name, config)
/// and the plain Personal variables `plain`.
async fn db_at_0012(
    path: &std::path::Path,
    servers: &[(&str, &str, Value)],
    plain: &[(&str, &str)],
) {
    let opts = SqliteConnectOptions::new()
        .filename(path)
        .create_if_missing(true);
    let pool = SqlitePool::connect_with(opts).await.unwrap();
    let mut before = sqlx::migrate!("./migrations");
    before.migrations = before
        .migrations
        .iter()
        .filter(|m| m.version < 13)
        .cloned()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .into();
    before.run(&pool).await.unwrap();
    for (id, name, config) in servers {
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO library_items (id, kind, name, config, owner_id, created_at, \
             updated_at) VALUES (?, 'mcp_server', ?, ?, NULL, '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', \
             '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z')",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .bind(name)
        .bind(config.to_string())
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    }
    for (name, value) in plain {
        sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO env_entries (name, kind, value, created_at, updated_at) \
             VALUES (?, 'plain', ?, '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z')",
        )
        .bind(name)
        .bind(value)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    }
    pool.close().await;
}

/// Whether the database at `path` still has migration 0013's list of servers to do.
async fn upgrade_0013_waits(path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    let opts = SqliteConnectOptions::new().filename(path);
    let pool = SqlitePool::connect_with(opts).await.unwrap();
    let left: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'upgrade_0013'",
    )
    .fetch_one(&pool)
    .await
    .unwrap();
    pool.close().await;
    left > 0
}

/// Migration 0013: each http server whose URL reads a variable gets the origin its URL reaches
/// with Personal's values now confirmed in Personal, so it keeps working; one whose origin
/// cannot be computed, a fixed URL (whatever its headers send) and a stdio server get none. It
/// runs once.
#[tokio::test]
async fn migration_0013_confirms_the_origin_each_http_server_reaches_now() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = dir.path().join("dots.db");
    let http =
        |url: &str, headers: Value| json!({"transport": "http", "url": url, "headers": headers});
    db_at_0012(
        &path,
        &[
            (
                "S1",
                "hosted",
                http(
                    "https://${MCP_HOST}/mcp",
                    json!({"A": "Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}"}),
                ),
            ),
            (
                "S2",
                "unset",
                http("https://${NOT_SET}/mcp", json!({"A": "${GH_TOKEN}"})),
            ),
            (
                "S3",
                "plain",
                http("https://plain.example/mcp", json!({"A": "fixed"})),
            ),
            (
                "S4",
                "github",
                http(
                    "https://API.github.com:443/mcp",
                    json!({"A": "${GH_TOKEN}"}),
                ),
            ),
            (
                "S5",
                "local",
                json!({"transport": "stdio", "command": "node", "env": {"T": "${GH_TOKEN}"}}),
            ),
            (
                "S6",
                "github-path",
                http(
                    "https://API.github.com:443/${GH_PATH}",
                    json!({"A": "${GH_TOKEN}"}),
                ),
            ),
        ],
        &[("MCP_HOST", "mcp.example:8443"), ("GH_PATH", "mcp")],
    )
    .await;

    let store = Store::open(&path).await.unwrap();
    assert!(upgrade_0013_waits(&path).await);
    // What Runtime::start does once the vault is open.
    let vault = Vault::in_memory(store.clone());
    assert_eq!(store.finish_0013(&vault).await.unwrap(), 2);
    let confirmed = |pairs: &[&str]| -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>> {
        match pairs {
            [] => BTreeMap::new(),
            list => BTreeMap::from([(
                PERSONAL_SCOPE.to_string(),
                list.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(),
            )]),
        }
    };
    let want = [
        ("S1", confirmed(&["https://mcp.example:8443"])),
        ("S2", confirmed(&[])),
        ("S3", confirmed(&[])),
        ("S4", confirmed(&[])),
        ("S5", confirmed(&[])),
        ("S6", confirmed(&["https://api.github.com"])),
    ];
    for (id, origins) in &want {
        assert_eq!(&store.confirmed_origins(id).await.unwrap(), origins, "{id}");
    }
    assert!(!upgrade_0013_waits(&path).await, "the list is dropped");

    // Once only: values set or changed since are not recorded by a second start.
    vault
        .add("NOT_SET", EntryKind::Plain, "late.example")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault.set_value("MCP_HOST", "moved.example").await.unwrap();
    store.close().await;
    let store = Store::open(&path).await.unwrap();
    let vault = Vault::in_memory(store.clone());
    assert_eq!(store.finish_0013(&vault).await.unwrap(), 0);
    for (id, origins) in &want {
        assert_eq!(&store.confirmed_origins(id).await.unwrap(), origins, "{id}");
    }
}

/// A store with no Library items, as a new data folder has: nothing to record, and the list
/// is still dropped.
#[tokio::test]
async fn migration_0013_on_a_store_without_servers_records_nothing() {
    let (dir, store) = temp_store().await;
    let path = dir.path().join("dots.db");
    assert!(upgrade_0013_waits(&path).await);
    let vault = Vault::in_memory(store.clone());
    assert_eq!(store.finish_0013(&vault).await.unwrap(), 0);
    assert!(!upgrade_0013_waits(&path).await);
    assert_eq!(store.finish_0013(&vault).await.unwrap(), 0);
}

/// The runtime runs the step at its start: a server from before 0013 starts where it did.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_runtime_start_confirms_the_origins_of_the_servers_from_before() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let data = dir.path().join("data");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&data).unwrap();
    db_at_0012(
        &data.join(dots_core::store::DB_FILE),
        &[(
            "S1",
            "hosted",
            json!({"transport": "http", "url": "https://${MCP_HOST}/mcp"}),
        )],
        &[("MCP_HOST", "mcp.example")],
    )
    .await;
    let mut cfg = dots_core::Config::new(data);
    cfg.port = 0;
    cfg.claude_path = Some(dir.path().join("no-claude.exe"));
    let rt = dots_core::Runtime::start(cfg).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        rt.store().confirmed_origins("S1").await.unwrap(),
        BTreeMap::from([(
            PERSONAL_SCOPE.to_string(),
            vec!["https://mcp.example".to_string()]
        )])
    );
    assert_eq!(rt.store().finish_0013(rt.vault()).await.unwrap(), 0);
    rt.shutdown();
}
```

**Create `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_org_origin_test.rs`:**

```rust
//! HTTP origin pinning per scope (env vault spec §8): an http MCP server whose URL reads a
//! `${VAR}` starts in a run only when the origin its URL reaches with the run's values was
//! confirmed for the dot's scope. A Personal value or an org's that moves the host leaves the
//! server out with a notice naming the server and the origin, never a value. A server whose URL
//! reads no variable has one origin and is never pinned, whatever its headers send.

mod common;

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use common::fake_mcp::{tool, FakeHttp, FakeMcp};
use common::orgs::{policy, sign, OrgsHarness, ACME, TOKEN};
use dots_core::events::new_bus;
use dots_core::library::{
    HttpOrigin, LibraryConfig, LibraryItem, McpServerConfig, SkillConfig, Uses, PERSONAL_SCOPE,
};
use dots_core::library_service::LibraryService;
use dots_core::run_tools::{OpenRequest, RunTools};
use dots_core::vault::{DotScope, EntryKind, Grants, Vault};
use dots_core::Error;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

const ORG_KEY: &str = "org-secret-api-key-5d93a1";
const PERSONAL_KEY: &str = "personal-secret-api-key-e2c47b";
const LITERAL: &str = "ghp_literalTokenForTheOriginTest0042";

/// Every secret a test serves or stores, which no notice or error may hold.
const SECRETS: &[&str] = &[ORG_KEY, PERSONAL_KEY, LITERAL, TOKEN];

fn assert_clean(text: &str) {
    for value in SECRETS {
        assert!(!text.contains(value), "{text:?} holds {value:?}");
    }
}

fn acme() -> DotScope {
    DotScope::Org(ACME.into())
}

/// The notice of a run whose server `name` reaches the unconfirmed `origin`.
fn not_confirmed(name: &str, origin: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        "{name}: {origin} is not a confirmed origin; open the server in the Library to confirm it"
    )
}

/// An http `fake-mcp`, the `host:port` it listens on, and its origin.
struct Served {
    fake: FakeMcp,
    http: FakeHttp,
    port: u16,
}

impl Served {
    async fn start() -> Served {
        let fake = FakeMcp::new(json!({"tools": [tool("query", true)]}));
        let http = fake.serve_http().await;
        let port = reqwest::Url::parse(&http.url).unwrap().port().unwrap();
        Served { fake, http, port }
    }

    /// `host:<port>`, a value of `MCP_HOST`.
    fn at(&self, host: &str) -> String {
        format!("{host}:{}", self.port)
    }

    /// `http://host:<port>`, the origin of a URL on `host`.
    fn origin(&self, host: &str) -> String {
        format!("http://{}", self.at(host))
    }

    /// The `Authorization` each initialize request had, in order.
    fn auths(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.fake
            .log()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|r| r["msg"]["method"] == "initialize")
            .map(|r| r["auth"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string())
            .collect()
    }
}

/// The pinned server: its host from `${MCP_HOST}`, its token from `${API_KEY}`.
fn pinned_config() -> LibraryConfig {
    LibraryConfig::McpServer(McpServerConfig::Http {
        url: "http://${MCP_HOST}/mcp".into(),
        headers: BTreeMap::from([("Authorization".into(), "Bearer ${API_KEY}".into())]),
    })
}

/// Acme joined with `MCP_HOST` (plain) and `API_KEY` from `entries`, its policy `personal:
/// deny`; Personal holding `MCP_HOST` on 127.0.0.1 and its own `API_KEY`; the server `gh`
/// added as the store adds it, with nothing confirmed.
async fn setup(
    served: &Served,
    entries: Value,
) -> (OrgsHarness, Vault, LibraryService, LibraryItem) {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    h.join_acme(entries, json!({"personal": "deny", "plain": ["MCP_HOST"]}))
        .await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    vault
        .add("MCP_HOST", EntryKind::Plain, &served.at("127.0.0.1"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("API_KEY", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_KEY)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let lib = LibraryService::new(h.store.clone(), new_bus()).with_vault(vault.clone());
    let item = h
        .store
        .add_library_item("gh", &pinned_config(), None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    (h, vault, lib, item)
}

fn org_entries(served: &Served, host: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"MCP_HOST": served.at(host), "API_KEY": ORG_KEY})
}

/// Opens a run of a dot in `scope` that uses the server `name` and grants it both variables.
/// Returns how many servers it opened and its notices, but for the one that holds a server
/// whose tool list is not accepted yet (no test here accepts one); each is checked for values.
async fn run(h: &OrgsHarness, vault: &Vault, scope: &DotScope, name: &str) -> (usize, Vec<String>) {
    let uses = Uses {
        mcp_servers: vec![name.to_string()],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let grants = Grants(
        [(
            format!("mcp:{name}"),
            vec!["MCP_HOST".to_string(), "API_KEY".to_string()],
        )]
        .into(),
    );
    let (tools, notices) = RunTools::open(OpenRequest {
        store: &h.store,
        bus: &new_bus(),
        run_id: "01RUN",
        uses: &uses,
        workspace: h.data.path(),
        plugins_dir: None,
        cancel: &CancellationToken::new(),
        vault,
        scope,
        grants: &grants,
        dot_name: "triage",
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    for notice in &notices {
        assert_clean(notice);
    }
    let opened = tools.servers().len();
    tools.close().await;
    let notices = notices
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|n| !n.contains("its tool list has not been accepted yet"))
        .collect();
    (opened, notices)
}

fn origins(pairs: &[(&str, &[&str])]) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>> {
    pairs
        .iter()
        .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect()))
        .collect()
}

// Which servers are pinned

#[test]
fn only_an_http_server_whose_url_reads_a_variable_is_pinned() {
    let http = |url: &str, header: &str| McpServerConfig::Http {
        url: url.into(),
        headers: BTreeMap::from([("X-Key".into(), header.into())]),
    };
    assert!(http("https://${HOST}/mcp", "plain").origin_pinned());
    assert!(http("https://api.example/${PATH}", "Bearer ${TOKEN}").origin_pinned());
    assert!(http("https://api.example/mcp?k=${KEY}", "plain").origin_pinned());
    // A fixed URL has one origin: what its headers send needs no pin.
    assert!(!http("https://api.example/mcp", "Bearer ${TOKEN}").origin_pinned());
    assert!(!http("https://api.example/mcp", "plain").origin_pinned());
    assert!(!http("https://api.example/${", "a ${not a name}").origin_pinned());
    let stdio = McpServerConfig::Stdio {
        command: "node".into(),
        args: vec!["${ARG}".into()],
        cwd: None,
        env: BTreeMap::from([("TOKEN".into(), "${TOKEN}".into())]),
    };
    assert!(!stdio.origin_pinned());
}

/// A server that sends no variables starts with nothing confirmed, and has no origin to
/// confirm or compute.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_server_that_sends_no_variables_is_never_pinned() {
    let served = Served::start().await;
    let (h, vault, lib, _) = setup(&served, org_entries(&served, "localhost")).await;
    let plain = LibraryConfig::McpServer(served.http.config(BTreeMap::new()));
    let item = h
        .store
        .add_library_item("plain", &plain, None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for scope in [DotScope::Personal, acme()] {
        let (opened, notices) = run(&h, &vault, &scope, "plain").await;
        assert_eq!((opened, notices), (1, Vec::<String>::new()));
    }
    assert_eq!(served.auths(), ["", ""]);
    let origin = served.origin("127.0.0.1");
    match h
        .store
        .add_confirmed_origin(&item.id, PERSONAL_SCOPE, &origin)
        .await
    {
        Err(Error::Invalid(why)) => assert_eq!(
            why,
            "the MCP server \"plain\" has no variable in its http URL: its origin needs no \
             confirmation"
        ),
        other => panic!("expected Invalid, got {other:?}"),
    }
    assert!(matches!(
        lib.origin_in(&item.id, &DotScope::Personal).await,
        Err(Error::Invalid(_))
    ));
    assert!(h
        .store
        .confirmed_origins(&item.id)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
```
