### Task 13: Organisations in Settings, and org rows in the Inbox

Spec §9: the person joins, updates, refreshes and removes orgs in Settings, and the Inbox's "Tools changed" names an org's rows and accepts in that org. The UI never recognises a core state by its English: `JoinPreview` says the auth kind and whether the key changes, and a SOPS join that waits answers `pending`.

**Files:**

- Create: `ui/src/screens/Organisations.tsx`
- Modify: `ui/src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`, `ui/src/screens/InboxScreen.tsx`, `ui/src/screens/library/{LibraryScreen,ToolsReview}.tsx` (`?scope=` and `catalogIn`), `ui/src/lib/{query,runtime-events}.ts`, `ui/src/api/types.ts`, `crates/dots-core/src/vault/org/service.rs` (`JoinPreview.auth`, `key_changed`; a SOPS join refused for lack of a recipient answers `Ok` with status `pending`), `crates/dots-core/src/runtime.rs` (a `pending` join starts no timer and sends no event), `apps/dots-app/src/contract.rs`
- Regenerate: `ui/src/api/__fixtures__/contract.json`
- Tests: `ui/src/screens/Organisations.test.tsx` (new); `ui/src/screens/InboxScreen.test.tsx` (+2), `ui/src/lib/runtime-events.test.ts` (+1), `ui/src/test/fixtures.ts` (`sample.orgs`, `sample.joinPreviews`, `sample.toolsChanged`; `org_list` answers `[]` by default); `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_orgs_test.rs`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 12's commands, types and event.
- Produces:
  - Core: `JoinPreview.auth: Option<BaoAuth>` (`None` for Infisical and SOPS) and `JoinPreview.key_changed: bool` (the key line is the last line of `changes`). `Orgs::join` answers a SOPS join that waits with `Ok(OrgSummary)`, status `pending`.
  - UI types: `T.BaoAuth`, `JoinPreview.auth`, `JoinPreview.key_changed`. Query keys: `keys.orgs = ["orgs"]` and `keys.orgSopsKey(orgId) = ["org-sops-key", orgId]`. `org_updated` marks `keys.orgs`, `keys.library` and `keys.inbox` stale.
  - `ui/src/screens/Organisations.tsx`:
    - `Organisations()`, the Settings section, a `<fieldset aria-label="Organisations">` right after the ChatGPT account.
    - `JoinDialog({ org?, onClose })`, in three steps: code, preview, sign-in details. The secret fields are cleared once sent.
    - `sourceText(kind, address)`, such as "OpenBao at https://…".
    - Tones: `connected` none; `offline`, `policy_invalid` and `pending` `text-needs`; `revoked` and `expired` `text-destructive`.
  - `ToolsReview`'s `scope?` prop and `catalogIn(entry, scope?)`. `LibraryScreen` reads `?scope=`. The Inbox's org rows are keyed `${server_id}/${scope}` and read "github (Acme Engineering)".
  - The copy the tests quote, among it:
    - "No organisation is joined on this PC.", "Join an organisation", "Check the key fingerprint with your admin before you go on."
    - "Send this key to your admin, then press Join", "Waiting for your admin to add this PC's key"
    - "Not updated: you declined the new policy key."
    - the remove confirm "The dots of Acme Engineering stay on this PC, but they can't run until you join it again. The saved copy of its variables and your sign-in details for it are deleted."

**Create `ui/src/screens/Organisations.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
import { act, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import type { JoinPreview, OrgSummary } from "@/api/types";
import { localDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { backend, later } from "@/test/backend";
import { sample } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { renderApp } from "@/test/render";

const [acme] = sample.orgs; // Acme Engineering, OpenBao, connected
const [newCode, keyChange] = sample.joinPreviews; // a new org; Acme's path and key change
// A join code's text: it holds no secret. The values below are made up for the tests.
const CODE = "eyJ2IjoxLCJvcmdfaWQiOiJhY21lLWVuZyIsIm5hbWUiOiJBY21lIEVuZ2luZWVyaW5nIn0";
const TOKEN = "hvs.ui-test-token-7f3a";
const PASSWORD = "ui-test-password-91c4";
const CLIENT_SECRET = "ui-test-client-secret-2b8e";
const AGE_KEY = "age1uitestpublickeyqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqszqgpqyqs3290gq";
// An error whose words name the recipient case: the UI goes by the answer, not by words.
const RECIPIENT = "could not join Design: this PC's key is not a recipient of the file";

/// Answers `org_list` with what the test holds, like the core.
function orgs(initial: OrgSummary[]) {
  let current = initial;
  backend.on("org_list", () => current);
  return {
    set: (next: OrgSummary[]) => {
      current = next;
    },
  };
}

const section = () => screen.findByRole("group", { name: "Organisations" });
const row = async (name: string) =>
  within(await section()).findByRole("listitem", { name });
/// No secret the test typed shows anywhere but in its own field.
const noSecretShown = () => {
  for (const secret of [TOKEN, PASSWORD, CLIENT_SECRET]) {
    expect(document.body.textContent).not.toContain(secret);
  }
};

/// Opens Join (or Update on `org`), pastes the code and previews it.
async function preview(user: ReturnType<typeof renderApp>["user"], org?: string) {
  if (org) {
    await user.click(within(await row(org)).getByRole("button", { name: "Update" }));
  } else {
    await user.click(
      within(await section()).getByRole("button", { name: "Join an organisation" }),
    );
  }
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog");
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Join code"));
  await user.paste(CODE);
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Preview" }));
  return dialog;
}

describe("Settings, Organisations", () => {
  it("lists each org with its status in the tone of that status", async () => {
    const statuses = sample.orgs.map((org, i) => ({ ...org, id: `org-${i}`, name: `Org ${i}` }));
    orgs(statuses);
    renderApp("/settings");
    // Plain while it works; the attention colour while it works from its copy, has a policy it
    // refused or waits; the error colour once its values are gone.
    const tones: Record<OrgSummary["status"], string | null> = {
      connected: null,
      offline: "text-needs",
      policy_invalid: "text-needs",
      pending: "text-needs",
      revoked: "text-destructive",
      expired: "text-destructive",
    };
    for (const org of statuses) {
      const item = await row(org.name);
      const status = within(item).getByText(org.status_text);
      const tone = tones[org.status];
      for (const other of ["text-needs", "text-destructive"]) {
        if (other === tone) expect(status, org.status).toHaveClass(other);
        else expect(status, org.status).not.toHaveClass(other);
      }
    }
  });

  it("shows the source, the key, the times and, when asked, the policy", async () => {
    orgs([acme]);
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const item = await row("Acme Engineering");
    expect(item).toHaveTextContent("OpenBao at https://bao.acme.internal");
    expect(within(item).getByText(acme.key_fingerprint)).toBeVisible();
    expect(item).toHaveTextContent(`Last fetch${localDateTime(acme.last_fetch_at)}`);
    expect(item).toHaveTextContent(`Saved copy until${localDateTime(acme.copy_until)}`);
    // The policy is folded away until asked for.
    expect(within(item).queryByText(acme.policy_summary[1])).toBeNull();
    await user.click(within(item).getByRole("button", { name: "Show the policy" }));
    for (const line of acme.policy_summary) expect(within(item).getByText(line)).toBeVisible();
    await user.click(within(item).getByRole("button", { name: "Hide the policy" }));
    expect(within(item).queryByText(acme.policy_summary[1])).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says when no org is joined", async () => {
    renderApp("/settings");
    expect(
      await within(await section()).findByText("No organisation is joined on this PC."),
    ).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("refreshes an org and shows its new status", async () => {
    const list = orgs([acme]);
    const offline = sample.orgs[1];
    backend.on("org_refresh", () => {
      list.set([offline]);
      return offline;
    });
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const item = await row("Acme Engineering");
    await user.click(within(item).getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(offline.status_text)).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_refresh")).toEqual([{ orgId: "acme-eng" }]);
  });

  it("asks before it removes an org, in words that say what goes and what stays", async () => {
    const list = orgs([acme]);
    backend.on("org_remove", () => {
      list.set([]);
      return null;
    });
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    await user.click(within(await row("Acme Engineering")).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove" }));
    let ask = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Remove Acme Engineering?" });
    expect(ask).toHaveTextContent(
      "The dots of Acme Engineering stay on this PC, but they can't run until you join it " +
        "again. The saved copy of its variables and your sign-in details for it are deleted.",
    );
    await user.click(within(ask).getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("alertdialog")).toBeNull());
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_remove")).toEqual([]);

    await user.click(within(await row("Acme Engineering")).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove" }));
    ask = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Remove Acme Engineering?" });
    await user.click(within(ask).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove" }));
    expect(
      await within(await section()).findByText("No organisation is joined on this PC."),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_remove")).toEqual([{ orgId: "acme-eng" }]);
  });

  it("joins with a token: the preview, then the token, which is cleared once sent", async () => {
    const list = orgs([]);
    backend.on("org_preview", () => newCode);
    const joined = later<OrgSummary>();
    backend.on("org_join", () => joined.answer);
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const dialog = await preview(user);

    expect(within(dialog).getByRole("heading", { name: "Join an organisation" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent("Acme Engineering");
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent("OpenBao at https://bao.acme.internal");
    expect(within(dialog).getByText(newCode.key_fingerprint)).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_preview")).toEqual([{ code: CODE }]);
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }));

    const token = within(dialog).getByLabelText("Token");
    expect(token).toHaveAttribute("type", "password");
    await user.type(token, TOKEN);
    noSecretShown();
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Join" }));
    // As `SourceCreds` serializes.
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_join")).toEqual([
      { code: CODE, creds: { kind: "token", token: TOKEN } },
    ]);
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Token")).toHaveValue("");

    list.set([acme]);
    act(() => joined.give(acme));
    expect(await screen.findByText("Joined Acme Engineering")).toBeVisible();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());
    expect(await row("Acme Engineering")).toBeVisible();
    noSecretShown();
  });

  it("joins with a username and password for a userpass mount", async () => {
    orgs([]);
    backend.on("org_preview", () => ({ ...newCode, auth: "userpass" }) satisfies JoinPreview);
    backend.on("org_join", () => acme);
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const dialog = await preview(user);
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }));
    expect(within(dialog).queryByLabelText("Token")).toBeNull();
    const join = within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Join" });
    await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Username"), "ana");
    // Both are needed.
    expect(join).toBeDisabled();
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Password")).toHaveAttribute("type", "password");
    await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Password"), PASSWORD);
    noSecretShown();
    await user.click(join);
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_join")).toEqual([
      { code: CODE, creds: { kind: "login", username: "ana", password: PASSWORD } },
    ]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());
  });

  it("joins Infisical with a machine identity", async () => {
    orgs([]);
    backend.on("org_preview", () => ({
      ...newCode,
      source_kind: "infisical",
      address: "https://app.infisical.com",
      auth: null,
    }));
    backend.on("org_join", () => acme);
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const dialog = await preview(user);
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent("Infisical at https://app.infisical.com");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }));
    await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Client id"), "cid-1");
    const secret = within(dialog).getByLabelText("Client secret");
    expect(secret).toHaveAttribute("type", "password");
    await user.type(secret, CLIENT_SECRET);
    noSecretShown();
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Join" }));
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_join")).toEqual([
      { code: CODE, creds: { kind: "machine", client_id: "cid-1", client_secret: CLIENT_SECRET } },
    ]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());
  });

  it("joins a SOPS org with this PC's key, and waits for the admin to add it", async () => {
    const list = orgs([]);
    const pending = sample.orgs.find((o) => o.status === "pending")!;
    backend.on("org_preview", () => ({
      ...newCode,
      org_id: "design",
      name: "Design",
      source_kind: "sops",
      address: pending.address,
      auth: null,
    }));
    backend.on("org_sops_key", () => AGE_KEY);
    // An error first, then pending twice, then joined.
    const answers: (() => OrgSummary)[] = [
      () => {
        throw { kind: "internal", message: RECIPIENT };
      },
      () => pending,
      () => pending,
      () => {
        list.set([{ ...acme, id: "design", name: "Design" }]);
        return { ...acme, id: "design", name: "Design" };
      },
    ];
    backend.on("org_join", () => answers.shift()!());
    const { user } = renderApp("/settings");
    const dialog = await preview(user);
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent(`SOPS file at ${pending.address}`);
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }));

    expect(await within(dialog).findByLabelText("This PC's key")).toHaveValue(AGE_KEY);
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_sops_key")).toEqual([{ orgId: "design" }]);
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent("Send this key to your admin, then press Join");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Copy the key" }));
    expect(await navigator.clipboard.readText()).toBe(AGE_KEY);

    // An error is an error, whatever its words.
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Join" }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(RECIPIENT);
    expect(within(dialog).queryByText("Waiting for your admin to add this PC's key")).toBeNull();
    // A pending answer is the wait.
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Join" }));
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText("Waiting for your admin to add this PC's key"),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(dialog).not.toHaveTextContent(pending.status_text);
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.callsTo("org_join")).toHaveLength(3));
    expect(within(dialog).getByText("Waiting for your admin to add this PC's key")).toBeVisible();
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());
    // This PC's key is the core's to read: nothing is sent for it.
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_join")).toEqual([
      { code: CODE, creds: null },
      { code: CODE, creds: null },
      { code: CODE, creds: null },
      { code: CODE, creds: null },
    ]);
    expect(await row("Design")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("updates an org: what changes, a key warning, and the saved sign-in kept", async () => {

  it("shows the core's error as it is, and clears the secret it was sent with", async () => {
    orgs([]);

        "Acme Engineering is joined already: use Update on it in the list.",
      ),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" })).toBeDisabled();
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());

    backend.on("org_preview", () => ({ ...keyChange, org_id: "beta", name: "Beta" }));
    dialog = await preview(user, "Acme Engineering");
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText("This join code is for org 'beta', not 'acme-eng'."),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("asks for the list again when an org is updated", async () => {
    const list = orgs([acme]);
    const { listening } = renderApp("/settings");
    await row("Acme Engineering");
    await listening();
    const revoked = sample.orgs.find((o) => o.status === "revoked")!;
    list.set([revoked]);
    act(() => backend.emit("runtime", { type: "org_updated", org_id: "acme-eng" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(revoked.status_text)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

**Create `ui/src/screens/Organisations.tsx`:**

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Copy, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { CommandError, commands } from "@/api/commands";
import type { JoinPreview, OrgSummary, SourceCreds } from "@/api/types";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/ConfirmButton";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ErrorNote";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { localDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { errorMessage, notifyError } from "@/lib/notify";
import { invalidate, keys } from "@/lib/query";

/// How an org's status reads: plain while it works; the attention colour while it works from
/// its saved copy, has refused a new policy, or waits for the admin; the error colour once its
/// values are gone.
const TONE: Record<OrgSummary["status"], string> = {
  connected: "",
  offline: "text-needs",
  policy_invalid: "text-needs",
  pending: "text-needs",
  revoked: "text-destructive",
  expired: "text-destructive",
};

const SOURCE: Record<string, string> = {
  openbao: "OpenBao",
  infisical: "Infisical",
  sops: "SOPS file",
};

/// "OpenBao at https://…", as the core's lines of what an Update changes name a source.
export function sourceText(kind: string, address: string): string {
  return `${SOURCE[kind] ?? "An unreadable source"} at ${address}`;
}

const WAITING = "Waiting for your admin to add this PC's key";

/// One joined org: where its values come from, how it stands, and Refresh, Update and Remove.
function OrgRow({ org, onUpdate }: { org: OrgSummary; onUpdate: () => void }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [policyShown, setPolicyShown] = useState(false);
  const refresh = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => commands.orgRefresh(org.id),
    // A failed fetch is a status, not an error: the list shows it.
    onSuccess: () => invalidate(qc, keys.orgs),
    onError: notifyError,
  });
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => commands.orgRemove(org.id),
    onSuccess: () => {
      invalidate(qc, keys.orgs);
      toast.success(`Left ${org.name}`);
    },
    onError: notifyError,
  });
  const policyId = `org-policy-${org.id}`;
  return (
    <li aria-label={org.name} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border p-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <span className="font-medium">{org.name}</span>
          <p className={`text-xs first-letter:uppercase ${TONE[org.status]}`}>
            {org.status_text}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          disabled={refresh.isPending}
          onClick={() => refresh.mutate()}
        >
          {refresh.isPending ? "Refreshing…" : "Refresh"}
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onUpdate}>
          Update
        </Button>
        <ConfirmButton
          title={`Remove ${org.name}?`}
          description={
            `The dots of ${org.name} stay on this PC, but they can't run until you join it ` +
            "again. The saved copy of its variables and your sign-in details for it are deleted."
          }
          confirmLabel="Remove"
          disabled={remove.isPending}
          onConfirm={() => remove.mutate()}
        >
          Remove
        </ConfirmButton>
      </div>
      <dl className="grid grid-cols-[max-content_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs">
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Source</dt>
        <dd className="break-all">{sourceText(org.source_kind, org.address)}</dd>
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Key fingerprint</dt>
        <dd className="font-mono">{org.key_fingerprint}</dd>
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Last fetch</dt>
        <dd>{localDateTime(org.last_fetch_at) || "Never"}</dd>
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Saved copy until</dt>
        <dd>{localDateTime(org.copy_until) || "No saved copy"}</dd>
      </dl>
      {org.policy_summary.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No policy accepted yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            className="self-start"
            aria-expanded={policyShown}
            aria-controls={policyId}
            onClick={() => setPolicyShown(!policyShown)}
          >
            {policyShown ? "Hide the policy" : "Show the policy"}
          </Button>
          {policyShown && (
            <ul id={policyId} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 pl-3 text-xs">
              {org.policy_summary.map((line) => (
                <li key={line}>{line}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

type CredsKind = "token" | "login" | "machine" | "age";

/// The sign-in details the code's source asks for: a token or a username and password for
/// OpenBao (as the code names), a machine identity for Infisical, this PC's key for SOPS.
function credsKind(preview: JoinPreview): CredsKind | null {
  switch (preview.source_kind) {
    case "openbao":
      return preview.auth === "userpass" || preview.auth === "ldap" ? "login" : "token";
    case "infisical":
      return "machine";
    case "sops":
      return "age";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

type Fields = {
  token: string;
  username: string;
  password: string;
  clientId: string;
  clientSecret: string;
};
const BLANK: Fields = { token: "", username: "", password: "", clientId: "", clientSecret: "" };
/// The fields without what is secret: what is left after a submit.
const unsecret = (f: Fields): Fields => ({ ...f, token: "", password: "", clientSecret: "" });

/// The details as `SourceCreds`; null when none were typed (and always for SOPS, whose key the
/// core holds). "partial" when some are missing.
function credsOf(kind: CredsKind | null, f: Fields): SourceCreds | null | "partial" {
  const typed = (values: string[]) =>
    values.every((v) => v !== "") ? "all" : values.every((v) => v === "") ? "none" : "some";
  const check = (values: string[], creds: SourceCreds) => {
    const t = typed(values);
    return t === "all" ? creds : t === "none" ? null : "partial";
  };
  switch (kind) {
    case "token":
      return check([f.token], { kind: "token", token: f.token });
    case "login":
      return check([f.username.trim(), f.password], {
        kind: "login",
        username: f.username.trim(),
        password: f.password,
      });
    case "machine":
      return check([f.clientId.trim(), f.clientSecret], {
        kind: "machine",
        client_id: f.clientId.trim(),
        client_secret: f.clientSecret,
      });
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/// This PC's public key for a SOPS org, to send to the admin. It is made on the first ask.
function SopsKey(props: { orgId: string; verb: string }) {
  const key = useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.orgSopsKey(props.orgId),
    queryFn: () => commands.orgSopsKey(props.orgId),
  });
  if (key.isError) return <ErrorNote error={key.error} />;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Field
        label="This PC's key"
        htmlFor="org-sops-key"
        hint={`Send this key to your admin, then press ${props.verb}`}
      >
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input id="org-sops-key" readOnly className="font-mono" value={key.data ?? ""} />
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="Copy the key"
            disabled={!key.data}
            onClick={() =>
              navigator.clipboard
                .writeText(key.data ?? "")
                .then(() => toast.success("Copied the key"), notifyError)
            }
          >
            <Copy aria-hidden /> Copy
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}

type Step = "code" | "preview" | "creds";

/// Join an org (no `org`), or Update `org` with a new code from its admin. Three steps: the
/// code, what it joins or changes, then the sign-in details its source needs. Secret fields
/// are cleared after every submit, and go with the dialog when it closes.
export function JoinDialog(props: { org?: OrgSummary; onClose: () => void }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { org } = props;
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("code");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<JoinPreview>();
  const [fields, setFields] = useState(BLANK);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
  const [declined, setDeclined] = useState(false);
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const set = (change: Partial<Fields>) => setFields({ ...fields, ...change });

  async function look(text: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(undefined);
    try {
      setPreview(await commands.orgPreview(text));
      setStep("preview");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
    setBusy(false);
  }

  function readFile(file: File | undefined) {
    if (!file) return;
    file.text().then(
      (text) => {
        setCode(text);
        void look(text);
      },
      (e: unknown) => setError(errorMessage(e)),
    );
  }

  const kind = preview ? credsKind(preview) : null;
  const creds = credsOf(kind, fields);
  async function submit() {
    if (creds === "partial") return;
    setFields(unsecret(fields));
    setBusy(true);
    setError(undefined);
    setDeclined(false);
    try {
      const joined = org
        ? await commands.orgUpdate(org.id, code, creds)
        : await commands.orgJoin(code, creds);
      invalidate(qc, keys.orgs);
      if (joined.status === "pending") {
        setWaiting(true);
        setBusy(false);
        return;
      }
      toast.success(org ? `Updated ${joined.name}` : `Joined ${joined.name}`);
      props.onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setBusy(false);
      // The person said no to the new policy key in the system dialog: nothing changed.
      if (e instanceof CommandError && e.kind === "cancelled") {
        setDeclined(true);
        setStep("preview");
      } else {
        setError(errorMessage(e));
      }
    }
  }

  function back() {
    setFields(unsecret(fields));
    setError(undefined);
    setWaiting(false);
    setStep(step === "creds" ? "preview" : "code");
  }

  // A code for an org joined already goes through its Update, and Update takes only its own.
  const refusal = !preview
    ? undefined
    : org && preview.org_id !== org.id
      ? `This join code is for org '${preview.org_id}', not '${org.id}'.`
      : !org && preview.existing
        ? `${preview.name} is joined already: use Update on it in the list.`
        : undefined;
  const verb = org ? "Update" : "Join";
  const required = !org && creds === null && kind !== "age";

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(next) => !next && props.onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{org ? `Update ${org.name}` : "Join an organisation"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {step === "code"
              ? "Paste the join code from your admin, or open the .dotsorg file they sent."
              : step === "preview"
                ? org
                  ? "Check what this code changes."
                  : "Check what this code joins."
                : kind === "age"
                  ? "This org's variables are in a file encrypted to each person's key."
                  : "Your sign-in details for the org's source. Dots keeps them in Windows " +
                    "Credential Manager and never shows them."}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {step === "code" && (
          <>
            <Field
              label="Join code"
              htmlFor="org-code"
              hint="The code holds no secrets: only where the org's variables are."
            >
              <Textarea
                id="org-code"
                rows={4}
                className="font-mono text-xs"
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Or open a .dotsorg file" htmlFor="org-code-file">
              <Input
                id="org-code-file"
                type="file"
                accept=".dotsorg"
                onChange={(e) => readFile(e.target.files?.[0])}
              />
            </Field>
          </>
        )}

        {step !== "code" && preview && (
          <>
            {step === "preview" && (
              <>
                <dl className="grid grid-cols-[max-content_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Organisation</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {preview.name}{" "}
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {preview.org_id}
                    </span>
                  </dd>
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Source</dt>
                  <dd className="break-all">
                    {sourceText(preview.source_kind, preview.address)}
                  </dd>
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Key fingerprint</dt>
                  <dd className="font-mono">{preview.key_fingerprint}</dd>
                </dl>
                {refusal ? (
                  <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
                    {refusal}
                  </p>
                ) : org ? (
                  preview.changes.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">This code changes nothing.</p>
                  ) : (
                    <ul aria-label="What changes" className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
                      {/* The core puts the line that warns of a new key last. */}
                      {preview.changes.map((line, i) =>
                        preview.key_changed && i === preview.changes.length - 1 ? (
                          <li key={line} className="flex gap-1.5 font-medium text-needs">
                            <TriangleAlert aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                            {line}
                          </li>
                        ) : (
                          <li key={line}>{line}</li>
                        ),
                      )}
                    </ul>
                  )
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Check the key fingerprint with your admin before you go on.
                  </p>
                )}
                {declined && (
                  <p role="status" className="text-sm text-needs">
                    Not updated: you declined the new policy key.
                  </p>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {step === "creds" && (
              <>
                {org && kind !== "age" && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Leave these empty to keep the saved sign-in details.
                  </p>
                )}
                {kind === "token" && (
                  <Field label="Token" htmlFor="org-token">
                    <Input
                      id="org-token"
                      type="password"
                      autoComplete="off"
                      className="font-mono"
                      value={fields.token}
                      onChange={(e) => set({ token: e.target.value })}
                    />
                  </Field>
                )}
                {kind === "login" && (
                  <>
                    <Field label="Username" htmlFor="org-username">
                      <Input
                        id="org-username"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        value={fields.username}
                        onChange={(e) => set({ username: e.target.value })}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Field
                      label="Password"
                      htmlFor="org-password"
                      hint={preview.auth === "ldap" ? "Your directory (LDAP) password." : undefined}
                    >
                      <Input
                        id="org-password"
                        type="password"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        value={fields.password}
                        onChange={(e) => set({ password: e.target.value })}
                      />
                    </Field>
                  </>
                )}
                {kind === "machine" && (
                  <>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      The machine identity your admin made for you.
                    </p>
                    <Field label="Client id" htmlFor="org-client-id">
                      <Input
                        id="org-client-id"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        className="font-mono"
                        value={fields.clientId}
                        onChange={(e) => set({ clientId: e.target.value })}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Field label="Client secret" htmlFor="org-client-secret">
                      <Input
                        id="org-client-secret"
                        type="password"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        className="font-mono"
                        value={fields.clientSecret}
                        onChange={(e) => set({ clientSecret: e.target.value })}
                      />
                    </Field>
                  </>
                )}
                {kind === "age" && <SopsKey orgId={preview.org_id} verb={verb} />}
                {creds === "partial" && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {org ? "Give every field, or leave them all empty." : "Give every field."}
                  </p>
                )}
                {waiting && (
                  <p role="status" className="text-sm text-needs">
                    {WAITING}
                  </p>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={props.onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          {step !== "code" && (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={back}>
              Back
            </Button>
          )}
          {step === "code" && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              disabled={busy || code.trim() === ""}
              onClick={() => void look(code)}
            >
              Preview
            </Button>
          )}
          {step === "preview" && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              disabled={!!refusal}
              onClick={() => {
                setDeclined(false);
                setStep("creds");
              }}
            >
              Continue
            </Button>
          )}
          {step === "creds" && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              disabled={busy || creds === "partial" || required}
              onClick={() => void submit()}
            >
              {waiting ? "Try again" : verb}
            </Button>
          )}
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/// Settings → Organisations (env vault spec §9): the orgs joined on this PC, Join, and per org
/// Refresh, Update and Remove. Nothing here ever shows a value or sign-in details.
export function Organisations() {
  const list = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.orgs, queryFn: commands.orgList });
  // The org to update; null to join a new one; undefined while the dialog is closed.
  const [joining, setJoining] = useState<OrgSummary | null>();
  const orgs = list.data ?? [];
  return (
    <fieldset
      aria-label="Organisations"
      className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4"
    >
      <legend className="px-1 text-sm font-semibold">Organisations</legend>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        An organisation's admin keeps its variables in OpenBao, Infisical or a SOPS file, and
        its signed policy says how dots may use them. Join one with the code your admin gives
        you.
      </p>
      {list.isError && <ErrorNote error={list.error} />}
      {list.isSuccess && orgs.length === 0 && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No organisation is joined on this PC.</p>
      )}
      {orgs.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {orgs.map((org) => (
            <OrgRow key={org.id} org={org} onUpdate={() => setJoining(org)} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <Button
        type="button"
        size="sm"
        variant="outline"
        className="self-start"
        onClick={() => setJoining(null)}
      >
        Join an organisation
      </Button>
      {joining !== undefined && (
        <JoinDialog org={joining ?? undefined} onClose={() => setJoining(undefined)} />
      )}
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```

```rust
/// A SOPS join that waits for the admin to add this PC's key joins nothing: the runtime starts
/// no timer for it and says nothing of it.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_join_that_waits_for_the_admin_starts_no_timer_and_sends_no_event() {
    let t = Rt::start().await;
    let timers = t.rt.org_timers();
    eventually("the start-up fetch", || !timers.starting_up()).await;
    let mut events = t.rt.subscribe();
    // A file encrypted to other keys: this PC's new key is not among its recipients.
    let file = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .join("tests/fixtures/sops/good.enc.json")
        .display()
        .to_string();
    let sops_code = code(ACME, ACME_NAME, sops_at(&file), &t.keys);
    t.rt.orgs().sops_identity(ACME).await.unwrap();

    let waiting = t.rt.join_org(&sops_code, None).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(waiting.status, OrgStatus::Pending);
    assert!(timers.running().is_empty());
    tokio::time::sleep(StdDuration::from_millis(200)).await;
    assert!(events.try_recv().is_err(), "no event for a join that waits");
    assert!(!t.orgs().is_joined(ACME));

    // Its refresh time comes and goes with nothing fetched or said.
    t.clock.set(at(START) + Duration::minutes(15));
    tokio::time::sleep(StdDuration::from_millis(200)).await;
    assert!(timers.running().is_empty());
    assert!(events.try_recv().is_err());
    t.rt.shutdown();
}
```

**Create `crates/dots-core/tests/vault_env_used_by_test.rs`:**

```rust
//! What the Env tab shows of each variable beside its value (env vault spec §9, deferred by
//! plan A §14): "used by", the dots of the variable's own scope that grant it, and, for a
//! Personal secret, whether its value is gone from the secret store. Neither reads a value, and
//! no listing carries one.

mod common;

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;

use common::orgs::{OrgsHarness, ACME, TOKEN};
use common::spec;
use dots_core::library::{LibraryConfig, McpServerConfig};
use dots_core::model::{Dot, DotRef, DotSpec};
use dots_core::store::Store;
use dots_core::vault::{EntryKind, Grants, MemorySecrets, SecretStore, Vault};
use serde_json::json;
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

const PERSONAL_TOKEN: &str = "personal-secret-gh-token-5d21a7";
const ORG_KEY: &str = "org-secret-api-key-93be04";
const ORG_URL: &str = "https://api.acme.example";

/// A secret store that counts the values read from it, so a test can tell that a listing
/// asked only for the keys.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Counting {
    inner: MemorySecrets,
    gets: AtomicUsize,
}

impl SecretStore for Counting {
    fn put(&self, key: &str, value: &str) -> dots_core::Result<()> {
        self.inner.put(key, value)
    }
    fn get(&self, key: &str) -> dots_core::Result<Option<Zeroizing<String>>> {
        self.gets.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        self.inner.get(key)
    }
    fn delete(&self, key: &str) -> dots_core::Result<()> {
        self.inner.delete(key)
    }
    fn keys(&self, prefix: &str) -> dots_core::Result<Vec<String>> {
        self.inner.keys(prefix)
    }
}

fn granting(name: &str, grants: &[(&str, &[&str])]) -> DotSpec {
    let mut s = spec(name);
    s.variables = Grants(
        grants
            .iter()
            .map(|(consumer, names)| {
                let names = names.iter().map(|n| n.to_string()).collect();
                (consumer.to_string(), names)
            })
            .collect(),
    );
    s
}

fn named(dot: &Dot) -> DotRef {
    DotRef {
        id: dot.id.clone(),
        name: dot.spec.name.clone(),
    }
}

async fn github_server(store: &Store) {
    let config = McpServerConfig::Stdio {
        command: "gh-mcp".into(),
        args: Vec::new(),
        cwd: None,
        env: [("TOKEN".to_string(), "${GITHUB_TOKEN}".to_string())].into(),
    };
    store
        .add_library_item("github", &LibraryConfig::McpServer(config), None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn used_by_lists_the_personal_dots_that_grant_the_name_in_any_case() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    github_server(&h.store).await;
    vault
        .add("GITHUB_TOKEN", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_TOKEN)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("LOG_LEVEL", EntryKind::Plain, "debug")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault.add("UNUSED", EntryKind::Plain, "x").await.unwrap();

    // Ticking the server grants it GITHUB_TOKEN; the shell grant is in another case.
    let mut uses_github = spec("nightly");
    uses_github.uses.mcp_servers = vec!["github".into()];
    let nightly = h.store.create_dot(&uses_github, None).await.unwrap();
    let triage = h
        .store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("triage", &[("shell", &["github_token", "LOG_LEVEL"])]),
            None,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store.create_dot(&spec("idle"), None).await.unwrap();
    // A dot of an org grants the same names: it reads them from the org, not from Personal.
    uses_github.name = "acme-bot".into();
    h.store.create_dot(&uses_github, Some(ACME)).await.unwrap();
    h.store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("acme-shell", &[("shell", &["LOG_LEVEL"])]),
            Some(ACME),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let listed = vault.list().await.unwrap();
    let used: Vec<(&str, Vec<DotRef>)> = listed
        .iter()
        .map(|e| (e.name.as_str(), e.used_by.clone()))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        used,
        [
            ("GITHUB_TOKEN", vec![named(&nightly), named(&triage)]),
            ("LOG_LEVEL", vec![named(&triage)]),
            ("UNUSED", vec![]),
        ]
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn value_missing_is_true_only_for_a_secret_whose_value_is_gone() {
    let (_dir, store) = common::temp_store().await;
    let secrets = Arc::new(Counting::default());
    let vault = Vault::new(store, secrets.clone());
    vault
        .add("GITHUB_TOKEN", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_TOKEN)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("NPM_TOKEN", EntryKind::Secret, "personal-secret-npm-3c7e19")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    vault
        .add("LOG_LEVEL", EntryKind::Plain, "debug")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let missing = |listed: &[dots_core::vault::EnvEntry]| -> Vec<(String, bool)> {
        listed
            .iter()
            .map(|e| (e.name.clone(), e.value_missing))
            .collect()
    };
    let gets = secrets.gets.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&vault.list().await.unwrap()),
        [
            ("GITHUB_TOKEN".to_string(), false),
            ("LOG_LEVEL".to_string(), false),
            ("NPM_TOKEN".to_string(), false),
        ]
    );

    // Its credential was deleted outside Dots.
    secrets.inner.delete("personal/GITHUB_TOKEN").unwrap();
    let listed = vault.list().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        missing(&listed),
        [
            ("GITHUB_TOKEN".to_string(), true),
            ("LOG_LEVEL".to_string(), false),
            ("NPM_TOKEN".to_string(), false),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        secrets.gets.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
        gets,
        "a listing reads no value"
    );

    // Setting it again (Replace value) brings it back, and the answer says so.
    let set = vault
        .set_value("GITHUB_TOKEN", PERSONAL_TOKEN)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(!set.value_missing);
    assert!(!vault.list().await.unwrap()[0].value_missing);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn no_listing_holds_a_value() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    let vault = h.vault();
    h.join_acme(
        json!({"API_KEY": ORG_KEY, "API_BASE_URL": ORG_URL}),
        json!({"plain": ["API_BASE_URL"]}),
    )
    .await;
    vault
        .add("GITHUB_TOKEN", EntryKind::Secret, PERSONAL_TOKEN)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("acme-bot", &[("shell", &["API_KEY"])]),
            Some(ACME),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store
        .create_dot(&granting("mine", &[("shell", &["GITHUB_TOKEN"])]), None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.secrets.delete("personal/GITHUB_TOKEN").unwrap();

    let personal = serde_json::to_string(&vault.list().await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    let org = serde_json::to_string(&h.orgs.entries(ACME).await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    for text in [&personal, &org] {
        for value in [PERSONAL_TOKEN, ORG_KEY, TOKEN] {
            assert!(!text.contains(value), "{text} holds {value:?}");
        }
    }
    // The plain value is the one value an org listing shows.
    assert!(org.contains(ORG_URL), "{org}");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_orgs_used_by_lists_only_the_dots_of_that_org() {
    let h = OrgsHarness::new().await;
    h.join_acme(
        json!({"API_KEY": ORG_KEY, "API_BASE_URL": ORG_URL}),
        json!({"plain": ["API_BASE_URL"]}),
    )
    .await;
    let bot = h
        .store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("acme-bot", &[("shell", &["api_key", "API_BASE_URL"])]),
            Some(ACME),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let docs = h
        .store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("acme-docs", &[("shell", &["API_BASE_URL"])]),
            Some(ACME),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // A Personal dot and another org's dot grant the same names.
    h.store
        .create_dot(&granting("mine", &[("shell", &["API_KEY"])]), None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    h.store
        .create_dot(
            &granting("beta-bot", &[("shell", &["API_KEY"])]),
            Some("beta"),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let entries = h.orgs.entries(ACME).await.unwrap();
    let used: Vec<(&str, Vec<DotRef>)> = entries
        .iter()
        .map(|e| (e.name.as_str(), e.used_by.clone()))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        used,
        [
            ("API_BASE_URL", vec![named(&bot), named(&docs)]),
            ("API_KEY", vec![named(&bot)]),
        ]
    );
}
```

```rust
/// A scope whose catalog row a change of the server reset to `unchecked` still has it stored,
/// unlike a scope that was never checked or run in: the Library keeps showing that org.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_catalog_reset_by_a_change_is_still_stored_in_its_scope() {
    let (h, _vault, lib) = setup(json!({"personal": "deny"})).await;
    let (_fake, item) = server_reading(&h.store, "sf", "API_KEY").await;
    let acme_catalog = |entries: Vec<dots_core::library_service::LibraryEntry>| {
        let entry = entries.into_iter().find(|e| e.item.id == item.id).unwrap();
        let scoped = entry
            .catalogs
            .into_iter()
            .find(|c| c.scope == ACME)
            .unwrap();
        (scoped.catalog.status, scoped.stored)
    };
    assert_eq!(
        acme_catalog(lib.list().await.unwrap()),
        (CatalogStatus::Unchecked, false)
    );

    lib.check(&item.id, &acme()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        acme_catalog(lib.list().await.unwrap()),
        (CatalogStatus::Changed, true)
    );

    let mut config = h.store.get_library_item(&item.id).await.unwrap().config;
    if let LibraryConfig::McpServer(McpServerConfig::Stdio { args, .. }) = &mut config {
        args.push("--changed".into());
    }
    h.store
        .update_library_item(&item.id, &config)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        acme_catalog(lib.list().await.unwrap()),
        (CatalogStatus::Unchecked, true)
    );
}
```

**Create `ui/src/screens/library/LibraryOrgs.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
import { act, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import type { EnvEntry, OrgEntry, OrgSummary } from "@/api/types";
import { backend } from "@/test/backend";
import { sample } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { renderApp } from "@/test/render";

import type { ServerEntry } from "./parts";

const [github, owned] = sample.library as [ServerEntry, ServerEntry];
const [acme] = sample.orgs; // Acme Engineering, connected
const revoked = sample.orgs.find((o) => o.status === "revoked")!;
const beta: OrgSummary = { ...revoked, id: "beta", name: "Beta Labs" };
const gamma: OrgSummary = { ...acme, id: "gamma", name: "Gamma" };
// GITHUB_TOKEN (nightly-tests grants it), LOG_LEVEL (not granted), NPM_TOKEN (value gone).
const [token, , npm] = sample.env as [EnvEntry, EnvEntry, EnvEntry];
// API_BASE_URL (plain, locked, acme-release grants it) and GITHUB_TOKEN (secret, not locked).
const [baseUrl, orgToken] = sample.orgEntries as [OrgEntry, OrgEntry];
// What a secret's value would look like if one ever reached the screen. Made up.
const LEAK = "ui-test-leaked-secret-6a1f0c";
const cancelled = { kind: "cancelled", message: "declined: nothing was sent or saved" };

/// Opens the Env tab with Personal's `env`, the joined `orgs` and each org's entries.
async function envTab(
  opts: { env?: EnvEntry[]; orgs?: OrgSummary[]; entries?: Record<string, OrgEntry[]> } = {},
) {
  backend.on("env_list", () => opts.env ?? sample.env);
  backend.on("org_list", () => opts.orgs ?? [acme]);
  backend.on("org_entries", (args) => opts.entries?.[args.orgId as string] ?? sample.orgEntries);
  const rendered = renderApp("/library");
  await rendered.user.click(await screen.findByRole("tab", { name: "Env" }));
  return rendered;
}

const section = (name: string) => screen.findByRole("region", { name });
const row = async (scope: string, name: string) =>
  within(await section(scope)).findByRole("listitem", { name });

describe("the Env tab's orgs", () => {
  it("shows Personal, then each org with its status and read-only rows it manages", async () => {
    await envTab();
    const org = await section("Acme Engineering");
    expect(within(org).getByRole("heading", { name: "Acme Engineering" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(org).getByText(acme.status_text)).toBeVisible();
    const names = within(screen.getByRole("tabpanel"))
      .getAllByRole("region")
      .map((r) => r.getAttribute("aria-label"));
    expect(names).toEqual(["Personal", "Acme Engineering"]);

    const plain = await row("Acme Engineering", "API_BASE_URL");
    expect(within(plain).getByText("plain")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(plain).getByText(baseUrl.value!)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(plain).getByText("Locked")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(plain).getByText("Managed by Acme Engineering")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(plain).queryAllByRole("button")).toEqual([]);

    const secret = await row("Acme Engineering", orgToken.name);
    expect(within(secret).getByText("secret")).toBeVisible();
    // Not locked: a Personal variable of that name takes its place.
    expect(within(secret).queryByText("Locked")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(secret).getByText("Managed by Acme Engineering")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(secret).queryAllByRole("button")).toEqual([]);
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_entries")).toEqual([{ orgId: "acme-eng" }]);
  });

  it("never shows a secret's value, in Personal or in an org", async () => {
    await envTab({
      env: [{ ...token, value: LEAK }],
      entries: { "acme-eng": [{ ...orgToken, value: LEAK }] },
    });
    expect(await row("Acme Engineering", orgToken.name)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await row("Personal", token.name)).toBeVisible();
    expect(document.body.textContent).not.toContain(LEAK);
  });

  it("shows the status of an org that gives no values, and no rows for it", async () => {
    await envTab({ orgs: [acme, beta], entries: { beta: [] } });
    const org = await section("Beta Labs");
    const status = await within(org).findByText(beta.status_text);
    expect(status).toHaveClass("text-destructive");
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.callsTo("org_entries")).toHaveLength(2));
    expect(within(org).queryAllByRole("listitem")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("names the dots that grant each variable, in its own scope", async () => {
    await envTab();
    expect(
      within(await row("Personal", "GITHUB_TOKEN")).getByText("Used by nightly-tests"),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(await row("Personal", "LOG_LEVEL")).getByText("Not used")).toBeVisible();
    expect(
      within(await row("Acme Engineering", "API_BASE_URL")).getByText("Used by acme-release"),
    ).toBeVisible();
    const secret = await row("Acme Engineering", "GITHUB_TOKEN");
    expect(within(secret).getByText("Not used")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("marks a secret whose value is gone, and sets it again with the edit dialog", async () => {
    let env = sample.env;
    backend.on("env_set", () => {
      env = env.map((e) => (e.name === npm.name ? { ...e, value_missing: false } : e));
      return { ...npm, value_missing: false };
    });
    const { user } = await envTab();
    backend.on("env_list", () => env);
    const gone = await row("Personal", "NPM_TOKEN");
    expect(within(gone).getByText("value missing")).toHaveClass("text-needs");
    expect(within(await row("Personal", "GITHUB_TOKEN")).queryByText("value missing")).toBeNull();

    await user.click(within(gone).getByRole("button", { name: "Set value" }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Set NPM_TOKEN" });
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Value")).toHaveAttribute("type", "password");
    await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Value"), "ui-test-npm-value-2d4b");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull());
    expect(backend.callsTo("env_set")).toEqual([
      { name: "NPM_TOKEN", value: "ui-test-npm-value-2d4b" },
    ]);
    await waitFor(async () =>
      expect(within(await row("Personal", "NPM_TOKEN")).queryByText("value missing")).toBeNull(),
    );
  });

  it("reads an org's entries again when the org is updated", async () => {
    const { listening } = await envTab();
    await row("Acme Engineering", "API_BASE_URL");
    await listening();
    const before = backend.callsTo("org_entries").length;
    backend.on("org_entries", () => [{ ...baseUrl, value: "https://api2.acme.example" }]);
    act(() => backend.emit("runtime", { type: "org_updated", org_id: "acme-eng" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("https://api2.acme.example")).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("org_entries").length).toBeGreaterThan(before);
  });
});

/// github with a changed list in Personal and in Acme Engineering (used by acme-release), never
/// checked in Beta Labs and used by none of its dots, and never checked in Gamma, used there.
/// `reset`: Beta Labs' list was stored once and reset to unchecked since (a server change).
function scoped(reset = false): ServerEntry {
  const personal = github.catalogs[0]!;
  const changed = { ...personal.catalog, seen_fingerprint: "fp-acme" };
  const unchecked = {
    ...personal.catalog,
    status: "unchecked" as const,
    accepted_fingerprint: null,
    accepted_tools: null,
    seen_fingerprint: null,
    seen_tools: null,
    checked_at: null,
  };
  return {
    ...github,
    catalogs: [
      personal,
      {
        scope: "acme-eng",
        catalog: changed,
        stored: true,
        used_by: [{ id: "D2", name: "acme-release" }],
      },
      { scope: "beta", catalog: unchecked, stored: reset, used_by: [] },
      {
        scope: "gamma",
        catalog: unchecked,
        stored: false,
        used_by: [{ id: "D3", name: "gamma-sync" }],
      },
    ],
  };
}

describe("MCP servers in each scope", () => {
  it("lists a server once, with its state in each org that checked it or uses it", async () => {
    backend.on("library_list", () => [scoped()]);
    backend.on("org_list", () => [acme, beta, gamma]);
    renderApp("/library");
    const server = await screen.findByRole("listitem", { name: "github" });
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("listitem", { name: "github" })).toHaveLength(1);
    const inAcme = await within(server).findByRole("listitem", {
      name: "github in Acme Engineering",
    });
    expect(within(inAcme).getByText("Tools changed")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(inAcme).getByText("Used by acme-release")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(inAcme).getByRole("button", { name: "Review" })).toBeVisible();
    const inGamma = within(server).getByRole("listitem", { name: "github in Gamma" });
    expect(within(inGamma).getByText("Unchecked")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(inGamma).queryByRole("button", { name: "Review" })).toBeNull();
    expect(within(server).queryByRole("listitem", { name: "github in Beta Labs" })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("keeps an org whose stored list was reset, though no dot of it uses the server", async () => {
    backend.on("library_list", () => [scoped(true)]);
    backend.on("org_list", () => [acme, beta, gamma]);
    renderApp("/library");
    const server = await screen.findByRole("listitem", { name: "github" });
    const inBeta = await within(server).findByRole("listitem", { name: "github in Beta Labs" });
    expect(within(inBeta).getByText("Unchecked")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(inBeta).queryByText(/Used by/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("keeps the Personal row as it was: its review accepts with no scope", async () => {
    backend.on("library_list", () => [scoped()]);
    backend.on("org_list", () => [acme]);
    backend.on("library_accept", () => github.catalog);
    const { user } = renderApp("/library");
    const server = await screen.findByRole("listitem", { name: "github" });
    await within(server).findByRole("listitem", { name: "github in Acme Engineering" });
    // The server's own Review, not the one in its Acme Engineering line.
    const review = within(server)
      .getAllByRole("button", { name: "Review" })
      .find((button) => button.closest("li") === server)!;
    await user.click(review);
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Tools changed: github" });
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Accept" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.callsTo("library_accept")).toHaveLength(1));
    const [args] = backend.callsTo("library_accept");
    expect(args).toEqual({ id: github.id, fingerprint: "fp-seen" });
    expect(args!.scope).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("reviews an org's list under the org's name and accepts it in that org", async () => {
    backend.on("library_list", () => [scoped()]);
    backend.on("org_list", () => [acme]);
    backend.on("library_accept", () => github.catalog);
    const { user } = renderApp("/library");
    const inAcme = await screen.findByRole("listitem", { name: "github in Acme Engineering" });
    await user.click(within(inAcme).getByRole("button", { name: "Review" }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Tools changed: github in Acme Engineering",
    });
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Accept" }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(backend.callsTo("library_accept")).toEqual([
        { id: github.id, fingerprint: "fp-acme", scope: "acme-eng" },
      ]),
    );
  });

  it("names the org in the review the Inbox's link opens", async () => {
    backend.on("library_list", () => [scoped()]);
    backend.on("org_list", () => [acme]);
    renderApp(`/library?review=${github.id}&scope=acme-eng`);
    expect(
      await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Tools changed: github in Acme Engineering" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
  });
});

/// An http server of the person's own whose URL reads a variable, so its origin is pinned:
/// confirmed in Personal, not yet in Acme Engineering.
const pinned: ServerEntry = {
  ...owned,
  id: "01J0PIN",
  name: "tickets",
  owner_id: null,
  config: { transport: "http", url: "https://${TICKETS_HOST}/mcp", headers: {} },
  confirmed_origins: { personal: ["https://tickets.example.com"] },
};

async function openForm(entry: ServerEntry, button = "Edit") {
  backend.on("library_list", () => [entry]);
  backend.on("org_list", () => [acme]);
  const view = renderApp("/library");
  const item = await screen.findByRole("listitem", { name: entry.name });
  await view.user.click(within(item).getByRole("button", { name: button }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: new RegExp(entry.name) });
  return { ...view, dialog };
}

describe("the server form's Check as and origins", () => {
  it("checks as Personal or as an org", async () => {
    backend.on("library_check", () => ({ ...github.catalog!, status: "accepted" }));
    const { user, dialog } = await openForm(github);
    const picker = within(dialog).getByLabelText("Check as");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(within(picker).getAllByRole("option").map((o) => o.textContent)).toEqual([
        "Personal",
        "Acme Engineering",
      ]),
    );
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Check" }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("Checked as Personal");
    await user.selectOptions(picker, "acme-eng");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Check" }));
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText(/Checked as Acme Engineering/),
    ).toBeVisible();
    const calls = backend.callsTo("library_check");
    expect(calls).toEqual([{ id: github.id }, { id: github.id, scope: "acme-eng" }]);
    expect(calls[0]!.scope).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("says nothing was checked when the origin is not confirmed, and changes nothing", async () => {
    backend.on("library_check", () => {
      throw cancelled;
    });
    const { user, dialog, listening } = await openForm(pinned);
    await listening();
    const lists = backend.callsTo("library_list").length;
    await user.selectOptions(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Check as"), "acme-eng");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Check" }));
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText("Not checked: you did not confirm the origin."),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("library_check")).toEqual([{ id: pinned.id, scope: "acme-eng" }]);
    expect(backend.callsTo("library_list")).toHaveLength(lists);
  });

  it("shows the confirmed origins per scope and confirms one in an org", async () => {
    backend.on("confirm_origin", () => null);
    const { user, dialog } = await openForm(pinned);
    const origins = within(dialog).getByRole("list", { name: "Confirmed origins" });
    expect(
      within(origins).getByRole("listitem", { name: "Personal" }),
    ).toHaveTextContent("https://tickets.example.com");
    expect(
      await within(origins).findByRole("listitem", { name: "Acme Engineering" }),
    ).toHaveTextContent("None yet");
    // Personal has one: only the org is offered.
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole("button", { name: "Confirm origin in Personal" })).toBeNull();
    await user.click(
      within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm origin in Acme Engineering" }),
    );
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(backend.callsTo("confirm_origin")).toEqual([
        { serverId: pinned.id, scope: "acme-eng" },
      ]),
    );
  });

  it("offers a plugin's own server the same, with its settings read-only", async () => {
    backend.on("confirm_origin", () => {
      throw cancelled;
    });
    const fromPlugin = { ...pinned, owner_id: owned.owner_id, confirmed_origins: {} };
    const { user, dialog } = await openForm(fromPlugin, "Details");
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("URL")).toBeDisabled();
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Check as")).toBeEnabled();
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm origin in Personal" }));
    expect(
      await within(dialog).findByText("You declined. Nothing was confirmed."),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(backend.callsTo("confirm_origin")).toEqual([{ serverId: fromPlugin.id }]);
  });

  it("offers no confirm for a server whose URL is fixed", async () => {
    const { dialog } = await openForm({ ...pinned, config: owned.config, confirmed_origins: {} });
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Check as")).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole("button", { name: /Confirm origin/ })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```rust
/// The dots of `scope` among `dots` that grant `name` to any consumer, in `dots`' order: the
/// Env tab's "used by". A dot reads only its own scope, so a dot of another scope that grants
/// the same name is left out.
pub fn dots_granting(dots: &[Dot], scope: &DotScope, name: &str) -> Vec<DotRef> {
    dots.iter()
        .filter(|dot| DotScope::of(dot) == *scope && dot.spec.variables.grants(name))
        .map(|dot| DotRef {
            id: dot.id.clone(),
            name: dot.spec.name.clone(),
        })
        .collect()
}
```

```rust
    /// Every personal variable (`env_list`). A secret's `value` is `None`.

        self.store.list_env_entries().await
    }
```

**with:**

```rust

    /// Every personal variable (`env_list`), with the Personal dots that grant it and whether
    /// a secret's value is missing. A secret's `value` is `None`.
    pub async fn list(&self) -> Result<Vec<EnvEntry>> {
        let entries = self.store.list_env_entries().await?;
        self.listed(entries).await
    }

    /// `entries` with `used_by` and `value_missing` filled in. Whether a secret has a value is
    /// read from the secret store's keys, so no value is read. If the keys can't be listed, no
    /// secret is marked missing and the failure is logged.
    async fn listed(&self, mut entries: Vec<EnvEntry>) -> Result<Vec<EnvEntry>> {
        let dots = self.store.list_dots().await?;
        let stored: Option<HashSet<String>> = match self.secrets.keys(PERSONAL_PREFIX) {
            // Credential Manager compares targets without regard to case.
            Ok(keys) => Some(keys.iter().map(|k| k.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect()),
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!("could not list the personal secrets: {e}");
                None
            }
        };
        for entry in &mut entries {
            entry.used_by = dots_granting(&dots, &DotScope::Personal, &entry.name);
            entry.value_missing = entry.kind == EntryKind::Secret
                && stored.as_ref().is_some_and(|stored| {
                    !stored.contains(&personal_key(&entry.name).to_ascii_lowercase())
                });
        }
        Ok(entries)
    }

    /// One entry, as `list` gives it.
    async fn listed_one(&self, entry: EnvEntry) -> Result<EnvEntry> {
        let mut listed = self.listed(vec![entry]).await?;
        Ok(listed.remove(0))
    }
```

```tsx
/// The badge of an org's entry that a Personal variable of the same name can't replace.
function LockBadge() {
  return (
    <Badge variant="outline" title="A Personal variable of the same name can't take its place.">
      <Lock aria-hidden /> Locked
    </Badge>
  );
}

/// One joined org's section: its status, then its entries, read-only: the org's admin manages
/// them. An org that gives no values (offline with no copy, expired, revoked) has no rows; its
/// status says why.
function OrgSection({ org }: { org: OrgSummary }) {
  const entries = useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.orgEntries(org.id),
    queryFn: () => commands.orgEntries(org.id),
  });
  return (
    <section aria-label={org.name} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-medium">{org.name}</h2>
        <p className={`text-xs first-letter:uppercase ${ORG_TONE[org.status]}`}>
          {org.status_text}
        </p>
      </div>
      {entries.isError && <ErrorNote error={entries.error} />}
      {entries.data?.length === 0 && org.status === "connected" && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">The org has no variables.</p>
      )}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {(entries.data ?? []).map((entry) => (
          <ItemRow key={entry.name} label={entry.name}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-sm font-medium">{entry.name}</span>
              <Badge variant="secondary">{entry.kind}</Badge>
              {entry.locked && <LockBadge />}
            </div>
            {/* A secret's value never reaches the screen, whatever the answer holds. */}
            {entry.kind === "plain" && (
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {entry.value}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{`Managed by ${org.name}`}</span>
            <UsedBy dots={entry.used_by} none="Not used" />
          </ItemRow>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/// The orgs a server is listed in beside Personal: each one where its catalog is stored (a
/// Check or a run made it, even one reset to unchecked since) or whose dots use the server. An
/// org that has neither has nothing to show.
function orgCatalogs(entry: ServerEntry): ScopedCatalog[] {
  return entry.catalogs.filter((c) => c.scope !== PERSONAL && (c.stored || c.used_by.length > 0));
}

/// A server's catalog in one org: its status, its Review, its error and the org's dots that use
/// it. Keyed by (server, scope).
function ScopeLine(props: { entry: ServerEntry; scoped: ScopedCatalog; onReview: () => void }) {
  const { entry, scoped } = props;
  const { nameOf } = useScopes();
  const name = nameOf(scoped.scope);
  const { label, className } = STATUS[scoped.catalog.status];
  return (
    <li
      aria-label={`${entry.name} in ${name}`}
      className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5"
    >
      <span className="text-xs">{`In ${name}`}</span>
      <Badge variant="secondary" className={className}>
        {label}
      </Badge>
      {scoped.used_by.length > 0 && <UsedBy dots={scoped.used_by} />}
      {scoped.catalog.status === "unreachable" && scoped.catalog.error && (
        <span className="text-xs text-destructive">{scoped.catalog.error}</span>
      )}
      {scoped.catalog.status === "changed" && (
        <Button size="sm" className="ml-auto" onClick={props.onReview}>
          Review
        </Button>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```
